title: Need access to the Marketing Share Drive
description: Hi, I just moved over from the Sales department. Can you please add me to the M:\Marketing folder? I can currently see the drive but get an 'Access Denied' error when trying to open it.
resolution: Added user to the 'Marketing-Read-Write' Active Directory security group and requested a log-off/log-on.

title: Cannot access shared HR drive
description: I am trying to open the Z: drive but I keep getting an 'Access Denied' error. My manager said I should have permissions for the 'HR_Restricted' folder. I am running Windows 11 Pro.
resolution: Reset the user's Active Directory group membership and refreshed the group policy on the local machine.

title: VPN login timeout
description: Trying to log in and it just hangs at 40%.
resolution: Cleared stale sessions on the VPN concentrator and advised the user to re-import the profile config file.

title: NAS volume unmounted unexpectedly
description: Our QNAP TS-h886 storage server suddenly dropped the iSCSI target connection around 02:00 AM. Several VMs hosted on this volume are currently in a paused state. We are seeing 'Target portal unreachable' errors in the vSphere logs.
resolution: Re-established network bond redundancy and forced a re-scan of the iSCSI HBA adapters on the host.

title: Packet loss on guest network
description: Multiple visitors have reported that they cannot load basic webpages while connected to the Guest_WiFi network. Signal strength is excellent, but DNS resolution seems to be failing intermittently.
resolution: Updated DNS forwarders on the guest gateway to use reliable public resolvers.

title: SSH access request to dev-srv-04
description: I need SSH access to dev-srv-04 for the upcoming performance testing. My public key is attached. Could you add me to the authorized_keys file?
resolution: Added the user's public key to the server's /home/user/.ssh/authorized_keys file and verified connection.

title: USB External drive not detected
description: I plugged my 2TB Western Digital drive into the USB 3.0 port on my workstation and nothing happens. The light on the drive blinks, but it doesn't show up in Disk Management. Frustrating because I have a deadline today.
resolution: Assigned a new drive letter in Disk Management and updated the USB host controller driver.

title: Can't get into the server room
description: The HID badge reader on the primary server room door is completely dead. I've swiped three different badges and nothing happens. The light on the reader isn't even turning on.
resolution: Reset the local access control panel (ACU-01) and re-seated the power connector.

title: Print jobs stuck in spooler
description: The ERP system sends print jobs that never arrive at the network printer. The spooler shows 'Error' status.
resolution: Updated printer firmware and corrected a routing issue that was blocking the print server's access to the printer's IP.

title: SSO Login Loop - Chrome
description: I'm stuck in a login loop when trying to access Salesforce. I enter my credentials, MFA approves, but it just redirects back to the login page. I've tried clearing cookies and cache on Chrome v122.
resolution: Cleared the browser's persistent storage and updated the SAML assertion settings for the user's profile.

title: Encryption error on external drive
description: I'm trying to backup some sensitive data to an encrypted WD My Passport drive, but the encryption software fails with Error Code 0x80040154. I've tried different ports on my workstation, but it's the same error.
resolution: Reinstalled the encryption driver and updated the device firmware. Confirmed compatibility with Windows 11 bit-locker standards.

title: Local storage full on design workstation
description: My drive is full again! I keep getting low disk space warnings on my MacBook Pro. I already deleted my downloads folder, but I can't finish my current project because the system won't let me save.
resolution: Cleared system cache, identified a 40GB Adobe After Effects media cache folder, and moved older project assets to cold storage.

title: New Hire Access Setup
description: We have a new hire joining on Monday. Please create their AD account, assign them to the Sales department group, and ensure they have access to the Salesforce platform.
resolution: Created AD account and provisioned Salesforce license via O365 group provisioning.

title: Internet is super slow today
description: Everything is just loading really slowly today. Websites take forever to open. I'm connected via Ethernet in the accounting wing.
resolution: Identified a massive background update sync from the server room; throttled traffic to prioritize user browsing.

title: VPN connection failure - Error 807
description: I am unable to connect to the corporate VPN from my home network. Every time I attempt to initiate the connection on my Windows 11 laptop, it hangs at 'Verifying credentials' and then throws Error 807. I have already restarted the Cisco AnyConnect client and rebooted my machine with no success.
resolution: Reset the user's VPN profile on the gateway and updated the local certificate store to resolve the handshake timeout.

title: USB drive corruption
description: My flash drive stopped working after I pulled it out while it was still saving. Now Windows 11 says 'You need to format the disk in drive E: before you can use it'. Please don't tell me I lost everything.
resolution: Performed a low-level CHKDSK recovery on the partition table and successfully recovered 95% of the data using data recovery software.

title: Adobe Creative Cloud login loop
description: Every time I try to launch Photoshop on my Windows 11 workstation, it prompts me to sign in, accepts my credentials, and then immediately boots me back to the sign-in screen. I have already cleared the OOBE and SLStore folders as suggested on the forums, but the issue persists. My machine ID is LPT-8842.
resolution: Resolved by clearing cached credential tokens in Windows Credential Manager and reinstalling the Creative Cloud Desktop app.

title: Guest Wi-Fi portal not loading
description: Hey! Heads up that the guest Wi-Fi captive portal isn't popping up for mobile users—everyone is getting stuck on "Connected, No Internet." We really need this squared away before the conference tomorrow. Thanks!
resolution: Restarted the WLC controller service and flushed the DNS entries for the portal redirect URL.

title: Adobe Acrobat crashes on startup
description: I am beyond fed up with Adobe Acrobat Pro DC. Every single time I try to open a PDF, the application crashes immediately. I’ve already wasted my time doing a full reinstallation of the entire Creative Cloud suite, and it didn't do a damn thing. I'm running Windows 11 Pro 22H2, and the Event Viewer is clearly pointing to the faulting module name: Acrobat.dll, version: 23.8.20470.0. Get this fixed, I have actual work to do.
resolution: Performed a clean registry scrub using the Adobe Removal Tool and reinstalled the application using the enterprise MSI installer.

title: MongoDB primary node flapping
description: The primary node in our MongoDB 5.0 replica set is restarting intermittently. Error logs indicate a heartbeat timeout. This is causing significant application errors every few minutes.
resolution: Investigated network stability between nodes; found a faulty NIC on the secondary node that was causing intermittent network drops. Replaced the NIC and performed a node failover to stabilize the cluster.

title: System slow after suspected malware
description: My computer has been incredibly slow since I accidentally clicked a link earlier. CPU usage for 'System' is pegged at 100%. I'm worried it's a crypto-miner.
resolution: Ran a full malware scan, removed a malicious browser extension, and restored system performance.

title: UPS Battery Warning
description: The APC Smart-UPS 3000 in the server room is throwing a "Battery Replacement Required" error on the LCD again. The input voltage is perfectly stable at 120V, yet the unit is incessantly beeping and driving everyone crazy. I need this dealt with immediately.
resolution: Scheduled maintenance window and replaced the hot-swappable battery cartridge; unit self-test passed.

title: Unrecognized File System on External Drive
description: My external USB drive shows up in Disk Management but it says the partition is 'RAW'. I have important client files on there. Is it possible to recover these?
resolution: Used CHKDSK /f to repair the file system metadata; data was successfully recovered and user was advised to run a backup.

title: Corrupted SQL database file
description: We are getting I/O errors on the SQL Server 2019 instance. The error log says 'SQL Server detected a logical consistency-based I/O error: incorrect checksum'. This is affecting our production order database.
resolution: Restored the database from the last valid transaction log backup and ran DBCC CHECKDB to confirm logical integrity; data access restored.

title: URGENT: Desktop icon moved
description: MY DESKTOP ICON MOVED TWO INCHES TO THE LEFT! EVERYTHING IS RUINED! THE STORAGE MAPPING IS PROBABLY CORRUPT! HELP ME IMMEDIATELY BEFORE THE WHOLE COMPANY COLLAPSES!
resolution: Relocated desktop icon back to original position. Confirmed no actual storage mapping or file integrity issues existed.

title: User account locked out
description: I am completely locked out of my PC again. I’ve only tried logging in twice with the correct password, and now it’s giving me an "Account Locked" error. This is incredibly frustrating and a total waste of my time. Please fix this immediately so I can actually get some work done.
resolution: Reset account lockout counter in Active Directory; identified a stuck background process on user's mobile device attempting to sync email with an old password.

title: Zoom audio echo
description: Hi, people on my team calls keep complaining that they hear themselves echoing when I speak. I'm using a Jabra headset on my iMac M2. How do I fix this?
resolution: Adjusted the audio input sensitivity in the Zoom desktop client and updated the Jabra Direct firmware.

title: Rack A-02 Power Outage
description: The entire rack in A-02 is completely dead and the PDU is showing a 0A load. This is ridiculous—I’m almost certain the breaker in the facility room tripped. Fix this immediately.
resolution: Reset the tripped circuit breaker in the PDU and load-balanced hardware to prevent recurrence.

title: Latency spikes during backups
description: Every time the midnight backup runs, our application servers experience massive disk latency. Our storage controller CPU hits 99% usage. We need a better schedule.
resolution: Adjusted backup jobs to run in staggered windows and enabled storage tiering to offload non-critical data.

title: High packet retransmission rates
description: Network dashboard shows high retransmission on the storage VLAN. It is unclear if the storage array is overloaded or the physical cabling is compromised.
resolution: Identified and replaced a damaged Cat6a patch cable causing physical layer signal degradation.

title: Cloud storage bucket permissions
description: We are receiving '403 Forbidden' errors when our application attempts to push log files to the S3 bucket 'prod-logs-storage'. We verified the IAM role has 's3:PutObject' permissions, but it's still failing.
resolution: Corrected the bucket policy which was inadvertently blocking access from the VPC endpoint.

title: Performance degradation after migration
description: Ever since we migrated from SQL Server 2016 to 2022, the report generation service is incredibly slow. We are getting timeouts on the report_gen_sp procedure. Everything worked fine yesterday before the upgrade.
resolution: Updated statistics on the affected tables and forced a plan recompile for the stored procedure to utilize the new Cardinality Estimator.

title: Site-to-site VPN tunnel down
description: The site-to-site tunnel between the NY and London offices dropped at 03:00 UTC. Phase 1 IKE negotiation is failing with an authentication timeout. No configuration changes were made on our side.
resolution: Renewed expired SSL/TLS certificates on the London branch firewall.

title: Unable to export data to CSV
description: Every time I try to run the export tool on the web interface, it just spins for a minute and then returns a 500 error. The logs say 'Memory limit exceeded'.
resolution: Optimized the SQL export query to use a cursor-based fetch instead of loading the full result set into memory.

title: UPS Battery Warning - Server Room B
description: The APC Smart-UPS 3000 in Server Room B is throwing an 'Replace Battery' alert on the front LCD. SNMP traps are flooding the monitoring dashboard with error code 0x02. Please schedule a replacement before the next power test.
resolution: Scheduled physical maintenance; replaced internal lead-acid battery cartridge.

title: New monitor setup
description: Hi, I just moved desks and my monitor won't connect to the docking station. It's an older Dell display, and I've tried both HDMI and DisplayPort cables. Nothing is appearing on the screen.
resolution: Updated the Thunderbolt docking station drivers and configured the display settings via Intel Graphics Command Center.

title: External USB drive not recognized
description: My Seagate 2TB drive isn't showing up in File Explorer when I plug it into my Dell Latitude. It worked yesterday, but now it just clicks repeatedly when I connect it to the USB 3.0 port.
resolution: Diagnosed as hardware failure of the drive head; advised user to contact a data recovery specialist as the drive was physically unresponsive.

title: USB stick formatted by accident
description: I accidentally clicked format on my 64GB Kingston USB drive. It had all my project assets on it. Please tell me you can get them back!
resolution: Ran data recovery software on the unallocated space of the drive and successfully recovered the file structure.

title: Adobe Acrobat Pro Licensing Issue
description: Hey, I keep getting a 'Licensing Service Not Available' error when trying to open PDFs. I'm on Windows 11 and re-signed into Creative Cloud, but it didn't help. This is blocking my document review process.
resolution: Performed a clean re-installation of the Adobe Creative Cloud desktop app and reset the local licensing token file.

title: Lost password
description: I forgot my network password. Can you reset it?
resolution: Verified identity via manager and performed a forced password reset on the domain controller.

title: Lost my YubiKey
description: I am writing to formally report the loss of my assigned hardware security key. Please provide instructions on the procurement process for a replacement device and the necessary procedures to revoke the credentials of the lost key from my account. As this device is essential for accessing internal systems, I request that this matter be prioritized to restore my ability to perform my professional duties.
resolution: Deactivated the lost hardware key in Okta and provided the user with a temporary bypass code until a replacement arrives.

title: SQL Server connection timeout on App-Prod-01
description: We are seeing intermittent 0x80004005 errors when the web front-end attempts to connect to the SQL Server 2019 instance. This started after the maintenance window last night. The app server is running Windows Server 2022.
resolution: Increased the connection pool size in the web.config and restarted the IIS application pool.

title: BitLocker recovery screen
description: My laptop (Dell Latitude 5420) is stuck at the BitLocker recovery screen every time I boot up. It's asking for a 48-digit recovery key that I don't have. I have a meeting in 10 minutes, this is a disaster!
resolution: Retrieved the recovery key from Azure AD device management and provided it to the user. Suggested a firmware update to prevent future boot loops.

title: Guest WiFi login page not appearing
description: The guest WiFi is completely broken on mobile devices. Instead of the redirect page actually appearing, users are just hit with a "connection not private" error every single time they try to log in. This is incredibly frustrating and needs to be fixed immediately.
resolution: Updated the SSL certificate on the captive portal gateway which had expired.

title: Slow data retrieval for dashboard
description: Dashboard takes 30+ seconds to load. We aren't sure if the network latency is high between the app server and DB, or if an index is missing.
resolution: Added missing non-clustered index on the primary table to reduce read time.

title: Wi-Fi is super slow in the lobby
description: Hey, the guest Wi-Fi in the lobby has been unusable for the last hour. My phone connects but I can't load a single webpage. Is the AP down?
resolution: Rebooted Lobby-AP-04; the device had cached old DHCP leases and was failing to assign new addresses.

title: BitLocker recovery screen on boot
description: My Dell Latitude 5420 is completely useless right now because it's stuck on a BitLocker recovery screen immediately after the BIOS post. It’s demanding a 48-digit recovery key that I don't have and was never provided. I need this resolved immediately; I cannot afford to be locked out of my machine any longer.
resolution: Retrieved recovery key from Azure AD portal and successfully unlocked the drive. Performed a 'manage-bde -protectors -adbackup' to ensure future recovery keys are synced.

title: Esxi host disconnected from vCenter
description: Host esxi-prod-04 has dropped from the vCenter inventory. I'm seeing 'Host not responding' errors in the dashboard. Physical power is on, but management IP is unreachable via SSH.
resolution: Physically reseated the management NIC; restarted the management agents (services.sh) on the host.

title: Visual Studio 2022 project build failure
description: I am getting a 'Metadata file could not be found' error when building my solution. It works fine for my colleague, but fails on my machine every single time.
resolution: Removed the hidden .vs folder in the solution directory and performed a clean build.

title: SaaS Application Login Loop
description: I am beyond frustrated—I cannot get into Salesforce at all because I’m stuck in a constant, infinite redirect loop. I’ve tried both Chrome v124 and Edge, but it’s the same broken mess on both. It’s painfully obvious that my session token isn't being parsed correctly by the IDP, and I need this fixed immediately so I can actually get back to work.
resolution: Cleared the browser cookies and cache, then performed a forced sync between Okta and the Salesforce integration app.

title: VPN connection failing with Error 809
description: I am completely unable to connect to the VPN from home because Cisco AnyConnect keeps hitting me with Error 809. I’ve already wasted my time restarting my router and fully updating my Windows 11 machine, but the tunnel still refuses to establish. This is unacceptable and I need this fixed immediately—I have to access the shared drive by EOD.
resolution: Modified client-side registry settings to allow UDP encapsulation for NAT-T, resolving the blocked IKEv2 traffic.

title: Cloud storage sync error
description: OneDrive is stuck on 'Processing changes'. I've cleared the cache and restarted the client on my MacBook Pro running macOS Sonoma, but it won't sync my Documents folder. Getting error code 0x8004de40.
resolution: Reset the OneDrive sync engine via the terminal and re-authenticated the user session; sync restored.

title: Phishing simulation alert for user j.doe
description: User j.doe clicked a link in a suspicious email titled 'Urgent: Payroll Adjustment' while using Windows 10 Pro. The email redirected to an external domain that mimicked our O365 login page. Antivirus blocked the secondary script execution, but the user may have entered credentials.
resolution: Reset user password, forced MFA token re-enrollment, and ran a full EDR scan on the device. No lateral movement detected.

title: Need access to production db for audit
description: Hi, I am working with the internal audit team and we need read-only access to the production 'Finance' schema. Please let me know what the process is for requesting this level of access.
resolution: Provided temporary read-only credentials with a 24-hour expiration after manager approval.

title: Forgotten MFA device
description: Hey, I’m traveling for a conference and realized I left my security key back at the office. I’m currently locked out of my email—any chance you can help me get access? Really need to check my inbox before tomorrow’s meeting.
resolution: Verified identity via manager approval and issued a temporary bypass code valid for 4 hours.

title: Update DB collation
description: We need to update our collation from SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS to Latin1_General_100_CI_AS_SC to support new emoji characters in user comments. Please advise on the downtime required for this migration.
resolution: Provided a maintenance window plan and a script to perform the column-level collation change during off-peak hours.

title: Core Switch Uplink Failure - Rack 4
description: We are experiencing intermittent packet loss on the primary uplink of the Cisco Catalyst 9500 switch in Rack 4. Port TenGigabitEthernet1/0/49 is flapping status every 15 minutes, causing latency spikes for the entire floor. Interface logs show 'ERR_DISABLE' due to excessive CRC errors.
resolution: Replaced the SFP+ transceiver and patched a new OM4 fiber cable; error count has stabilized.

title: NFS mount timeout on production web server
description: Our web server (srv-prod-04, Ubuntu 22.04) is experiencing intermittent NFS timeouts when accessing the shared NAS volume. The logs show 'nfs: server 10.0.5.20 not responding, still trying' every few minutes. This is causing significant latency for our file-upload service.
resolution: Increased the NFS read/write buffer sizes in /etc/fstab and verified the MTU settings on the storage controller to resolve packet fragmentation.

title: Account locked out - multiple failed attempts
description: My domain account is locked again. I tried logging into my workstation (WS-992) running Windows 11 but got error code 0x80090006. I haven't changed my password recently, so I have no idea why it keeps failing.
resolution: Reset AD account lockout status and performed a credential clear on the local machine; user advised to check for saved credentials in Credential Manager.

title: Disk space alert on DB-Cluster-02
description: The monitoring system alerted that the /var/lib/mysql partition on DB-Cluster-02 is at 94% capacity. We need to clear some logs or expand the volume before the service crashes.
resolution: Purged binary logs older than 7 days and expanded the EBS volume by 100GB.

title: User account locked out
description: I can't log in to my PC. It keeps saying 'Account Locked' after I tried entering my password twice. I am definitely using the right password. Please fix this.
resolution: Reset account lockout counter in Active Directory; identified a stuck background process on user's mobile device attempting to sync email with an old password.

title: User account compromise suspected
description: We are seeing successful login attempts for user 'jdoe' from an IP address in a country where we have no operations. The logs show massive file access within SharePoint immediately after the login.
resolution: Disabled user account, invalidated all OAuth tokens, and initiated an incident response forensic investigation.

title: Unable to connect to Mongo Atlas
description: I am writing to formally report a persistent technical issue regarding our MongoDB cluster. Despite repeated attempts to establish a connection via MongoDB Compass, I am consistently encountering a "connection refused" error. Please be advised that I have already verified my configuration, and my current home office IP address is correctly included in the authorized whitelist. For your reference, this issue is occurring on a device running macOS Monterey. Please investigate this matter with urgency, as it is currently impeding my ability to perform required database operations.
resolution: Found that the user's ISP had rotated their public IP address; updated the whitelist in the MongoDB Atlas dashboard.

title: Printer offline
description: The department printer in Building B is showing offline again. Can someone come reset the static IP? It happens every time we have a power flicker.
resolution: Assigned a DHCP reservation for the printer's MAC address to prevent future IP conflicts.

title: GitLab access request
description: Requesting access to the 'mobile-app-frontend' repository for our new intern. They need read-only access to view the codebase.
resolution: Added the user to the 'interns-read-only' GitLab access group.

title: Minor icon change on desktop
description: MAYDAY! MAYDAY! THE NETWORK ICON ON MY TASKBAR CHANGED FROM BLUE TO GREY! THE SYSTEM IS COLLAPSING! SEND AN IT ENGINEER TO MY DESK THIS SECOND OR THE WHOLE DEPARTMENT WILL COLLAPSE!
resolution: Updated network driver and confirmed stable connection.

title: Drive failure in RAID array
description: This is to formally report a critical hardware failure regarding server SRV-PROD-04. The storage controller is currently emitting an audible alert, and the management console indicates that Disk 3 within the RAID 5 array has transitioned to a "Failed" status. Please initiate an urgent onsite service request to replace the defective drive immediately to prevent potential data loss or further array instability.
resolution: Physically swapped the faulty drive and initiated a RAID rebuild which completed successfully after 4 hours.

title: WiFi is slow again
description: Can someone look at the access points in the lobby? Guests are complaining that the internet is crawling. My laptop shows a strong signal but we are getting < 2Mbps throughput on the 5GHz band.
resolution: Identified high channel interference; adjusted AP power levels and moved to non-overlapping channels 36 and 149.

title: Switch port flapping
description: Port 24 on Switch-Floor-3 is flapping constantly. The logs show '%LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN: Line protocol on Interface GigabitEthernet0/24, changed state to down'. It's impacting several users in the front office.
resolution: Replaced the damaged Cat6 cabling run between the wall jack and the desk.

title: EMERGENCY: NEED HELP RIGHT NOW OR I WILL BE FIRED
description: Hi, I was wondering if you could help me change the font color in the query result window to something a bit more aesthetic? It's just a personal preference for my daily reports.
resolution: Guided user through the IDE settings menu to change the result set UI theme.

title: Slow VPN speeds
description: It's super slow today. My RDP session to the file server keeps lagging out. Is the firewall saturated? I'm on Windows 11 and using the latest Cisco AnyConnect client.
resolution: Identified high bandwidth utilization from a backup job; rescheduled backup to off-peak hours.

title: Need root access on dev box
description: I need sudo privileges on server 'LINUX-WEB-04' to install some dependencies. Can you elevate my account? My username is j.doe.
resolution: Denied request per security policy. Instructed user to submit a ticket for the specific package installation via the DevOps team.

title: Slow read/write speeds on SAN
description: We are experiencing significant latency on the primary database cluster. Latency is spiking over 200ms during peak hours. Our Linux VMs are reporting I/O wait times that are killing application performance.
resolution: Identified a noisy neighbor VM consuming IOPS; implemented QoS policies on the SAN fabric to throttle the offending workload.

title: VPN connectivity issues
description: Hey, I can't seem to connect to the office network via Cisco AnyConnect on my Windows 11 machine. I keep getting 'Connection attempt failed due to server certificate validation error'. Super annoying.
resolution: Updated the root certificate store and reinstalled the VPN client profile; connectivity restored.

title: Cannot map network drive Z:
description: I just logged in to my Windows 11 machine and my Z: drive is missing with a red X. It says the network path was not found. Please fix this quickly, I have a deadline.
resolution: Cleared stale SMB sessions on the file server and re-mapped the drive via Group Policy.

title: Disk space alert on production cluster
description: Partition /var/lib/mysql is at 98% capacity. Automated backups are failing to trigger due to lack of space. Please clear temp files or expand the volume immediately.
resolution: Purged binary logs older than 7 days and expanded the LVM partition by 50GB.

title: URGENT: Production DB down
description: The entire database is unresponsive! Users are getting login failures and the dashboard is blank. It was working fine ten minutes ago. Fix this now!
resolution: Identified a memory leak in a stored procedure that caused the SQL process to hit the max server memory limit; restarted the SQL Server service and purged the procedure cache.

title: Account Disabled
description: My account is disabled! I can't log into my laptop or email. I have a meeting in 10 minutes, please help!
resolution: Account was disabled by mistake during a bulk cleanup script. Re-enabled and restored group memberships.

title: MFA Loop
description: I'm stuck in an endless MFA loop on my iPhone 14 when trying to access the Azure portal. It keeps asking for the authenticator code, and after I enter it, it redirects me right back to the sign-in page. Very annoying.
resolution: Unregistered and re-registered the user's device in the Azure MFA portal.

title: Account lockout after failed VPN attempts
description: My account keeps locking out every time I try to connect to the GlobalProtect VPN on my Windows 11 laptop. I’ve checked my credentials and they are correct, but the event viewer shows event ID 4625 for multiple failed attempts. Please reset my account status and investigate the sync error.
resolution: Cleared cached credentials in Windows Credential Manager and performed a manual sync with the Active Directory domain controller.

title: LUN masking visibility issue
description: Hey, we just added a new Linux host to the fabric, but it’s not picking up its LUNs. The zoning looks solid on the Brocade switches, but the storage array isn't seeing the HBA's WWN as logged in. Any ideas?
resolution: Corrected the zoning configuration by adding the missing WWN alias to the specific fabric zone.

title: Chrome plugin broken
description: The internal password manager extension is greyed out. It won't let me click the icon to sign in. It was working yesterday just fine.
resolution: Updated Chrome to the latest version, which resolved an incompatibility issue with the current extension manifest v3.

title: Suspicious phishing email reporting
description: I received an email from an external address pretending to be the HR department asking for payroll verification. It includes a suspicious link to a non-company domain. I haven't clicked anything, but wanted to report it to security.
resolution: Verified the email as a phishing attempt, blocked the sender domain on the mail gateway, and purged the message from the user's inbox.

title: Need permissions for Excel Add-in
description: Every time I try to run the Finance Add-in in Excel, I get a message saying I need admin privileges to authorize the script. Can you help me fix this so I don't have to call IT every time?
resolution: Whitelisted the specific Add-in manifest file in the organization's Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

title: External drive not detected
description: I plugged in my WD My Passport drive to copy some files, but my laptop doesn't show it in File Explorer. The light on the drive is blinking, but Disk Management just shows it as 'Unknown/Not Initialized'.
resolution: Assigned a new drive letter and updated the USB mass storage driver in Device Manager.

title: Database connection timeout
description: Heads up, the internal BI dashboard is timing out after 30 seconds. Looks like a backend issue, just flagging it now before the users start flooding us with tickets.
resolution: Increased the SQL query timeout threshold on the application server connection string.

title: Slack notifications not appearing
description: I'm not getting any push notifications on my Slack app. I've checked my system settings and the Slack internal settings, but they seem fine. Running on Windows 10.
resolution: Re-registered the Windows Notification Service (WNS) and verified that Slack is allowed to run in the background.

title: Restoration request for dev-db
description: Accidentally dropped a table in the development environment. Can you restore it from last night's backup? It's the 'user_prefs' table.
resolution: Restored the 'user_prefs' table from the 02:00 UTC snapshot to a temporary schema and instructed the developer to perform the data migration.

title: Data Loss Prevention alert triggered
description: System flagged me for uploading a spreadsheet to a cloud drive. It was just an internal project plan, why is the DLP policy blocking this?
resolution: Reviewed DLP rule violation and updated the sensitivity label on the file to prevent further false-positive blocks.

title: Database connection error in proprietary software
description: Getting 'Error 0x80040E4D: Login failed for user' when opening the Inventory Management Tool. I verified my credentials, and they work on the web portal. Please investigate.
resolution: Reset the user's password in Active Directory and force-synced the identity provider with the local database server.

title: Office printer offline
description: The big Xerox copier on the 3rd floor is offline again. It says 'Network Error' on the screen. I've tried rebooting it, but that didn't help.
resolution: Corrected an IP address conflict; assigned a static reservation in the DHCP scope to prevent the printer from grabbing an existing address.

title: Permission error on DB access
description: Why can't I write to the marketing database anymore? I keep getting 'Access denied for user 'data_analyst' at host '10.0.4.15''. It was working perfectly yesterday.
resolution: Re-granted the missing UPDATE and INSERT privileges to the user role after a security audit mistakenly revoked them.

title: Slow read/write speeds on shared network drive
description: I am writing to formally report persistent performance degradation affecting the Z: drive, which has resulted in significant latency and operational inefficiencies for end users. Accessing even small Microsoft Excel files requires an unacceptable amount of time, indicating a critical service impairment. Our internal diagnostics confirm that the infrastructure is running on Windows Server 2019, and there is a direct correlation between these latency spikes and the execution of the scheduled daily incremental backup task. Please investigate this matter with urgency, as the current state of the shared drive is impeding standard workflow.
resolution: Adjusted the QoS policy on the network switch and rescheduled the backup window to off-peak hours to reduce I/O contention.

title: Disk space full on File Server
description: I am writing to formally report that the E: drive on server FS01 has reached 98% capacity, resulting in the continuous generation of Event ID 2013 alerts. Please advise whether an expansion of the LUN size can be facilitated to remediate this issue, or if immediate manual intervention is required to purge system logs to restore adequate storage space.
resolution: Expanded the underlying LUN by 500GB via the SAN console and extended the volume in Disk Management.

title: External site blocked
description: I need access to specific documentation on an external portal but our firewall is blocking it with a 'Category: Malicious Content' message. Can you whitelist it?
resolution: Verified site reputation and added the FQDN to the firewall bypass list for the marketing department VLAN.

title: Incorrect capacity reporting
description: The web interface says the storage pool is 90% full, but the individual volumes only total 40% usage. Is there a hidden snapshot bloat or metadata error? It's been like this for three days.
resolution: Performed a filesystem check (fsck) to prune orphaned snapshot blocks that were not being reported in the main UI.

title: Minor latency on secondary backup drive
description: I've noticed that file transfers are taking about 3 seconds longer than usual. It's not a big deal at all, please look at it whenever you have a free moment next week.
resolution: Investigated storage array; identified a failing disk controller causing cache latency. Replaced controller and performed data parity check.

title: Office lights are flickering
description: I think this is an IT issue? The lights above my cubicle are blinking. Could this be related to the power surge we had earlier?
resolution: Directed ticket to Facilities department; identified as a failing ballast in the overhead fluorescent lighting.

title: Adobe CC license error
description: I keep getting a pop-up saying 'License expired' when I launch Photoshop. I am logged into my company account, but it doesn't seem to sync the license from the Creative Cloud portal.
resolution: Logged the user out of the Adobe desktop application, cleared the OOBE cache folder, and logged back in to refresh the license.

title: UPS Battery Warning
description: APC Smart-UPS 3000 in the server room is reporting 'Battery Replacement Required' on the LCD. Input voltage is stable at 120V, but the unit is beeping intermittently.
resolution: Scheduled maintenance window and replaced the hot-swappable battery cartridge; unit self-test passed.

title: Cannot reach external website
description: My browser is returning a connection timeout when I try to visit our external cloud accounting software. I can reach Google fine, so I know the internet is up. It’s just this specific URL.
resolution: White-listed the cloud provider's new IP range on the edge firewall.

title: Intermittent packet loss on VLAN 20
description: Users in the Finance department are reporting jittery VoIP calls and slow application performance. Running a continuous ping to the gateway shows about 15% packet loss. This has been going on since 9:00 AM.
resolution: Discovered a failing SFP+ transceiver on the distribution switch causing CRC errors; replaced the module and verified fiber link stability.

title: Users disconnected from remote desktop application
description: Remote staff are being kicked out of the virtual desktop environment with a 'Connection Lost' error.
resolution: Adjusted firewall session timeouts that were terminating idle VDI connections prematurely.

title: Guest Wi-Fi is down
description: Our visitors are completely unable to connect to the Guest network. They’re stuck staring at the splash page, and the authentication fails every single time they try to log in. This is becoming a major issue, so please get it fixed immediately.
resolution: Restarted the WLC authentication service which had stopped responding; guest portal is now successfully issuing tokens.

title: VPN connection dropping repeatedly
description: My Cisco AnyConnect client keeps disconnecting every 10-15 minutes while I'm working from home. I am running Windows 11 and getting the error message 'The VPN connection has been interrupted'. It's making it impossible to finish my reports on time.
resolution: Updated the AnyConnect client to version 4.10 and cleared the local DNS cache to resolve intermittent tunnel timeouts.

title: BitLocker recovery screen loop
description: My laptop (Dell Latitude 5420) is stuck on the BitLocker recovery screen after a BIOS update. I don't have the recovery key handy. I need this fixed ASAP as I have a client demo in an hour.
resolution: Retrieved BitLocker recovery key from Intune device management console and successfully bypassed the prompt to restore Windows boot environment.

title: Request for updated calendar icon
description: THIS IS AN EMERGENCY. MY CALENDAR ICON IS SLIGHTLY BLURRY ON MY MONITOR AND IT IS CAUSING ME EXTREME PSYCHOLOGICAL DISTRESS. I AM UNABLE TO WORK UNTIL THIS IS RESOLVED. PLEASE HELP!!
resolution: Cleared the icon cache and refreshed the desktop shortcut.

title: Unauthorized MAC address alert
description: The IDS flagged an unknown device connected to the production switch port Gi0/14. I am currently away from the office, but please investigate immediately. This looks like a potential security breach.
resolution: Physically traced the cable to an unmanaged hub installed by a user under their desk; removed the hub and disabled the port via switch management.

title: Issue with MFA prompt
description: My Authenticator app on my iPhone 15 isn't showing the push notification for Microsoft 365 logins. I've restarted the phone and reinstalled the app, but no luck.
resolution: Removed the device from the user's MFA settings in Azure AD and prompted for a re-enrollment flow.

title: Intermittent connectivity on VLAN 20
description: We are seeing intermittent drops across the accounting floor. Syslog shows spanning-tree topology changes occurring every 30 seconds. Could you investigate the stack switches in the server room?
resolution: Replaced a faulty SFP module in the core switch that was causing flap events on the trunk link.

title: File permission issues after migration
description: I moved files from the old server to the new one, but now nobody can open the Excel sheets. It says 'Access Denied'. This is very frustrating as my team is blocked.
resolution: Corrected NTFS permission inheritance settings and re-applied the correct security groups to the top-level folder.

title: GitLab access issues
description: I'm getting 403 Forbidden when trying to push code to our repo. My SSH key is set up correctly in the dashboard, but I think my user group membership was stripped during the migration to the new instance.
resolution: Added the user to the 'Dev-Ops' GitLab group and ran a permissions sync to update the upstream repositories.

title: Data center flood in progress
description: It's quite pleasant here, but there appears to be a minor trickle of water reaching the server floor. If you could eventually look into this, that would be lovely.
resolution: Stopped pipe leak and deployed industrial dehumidifiers. Moved mission-critical storage arrays to high-ground racks.

title: Guest Wi-Fi Down
description: The Guest_Wifi is completely dead in the lobby again. I’ve already checked the WAP-Lobby-01 unit and the status light is just blinking amber, so it’s clearly failing. I tried restarting it through the controller, but that didn't do a single thing to fix it. Can someone please actually get this working?
resolution: Factory reset the WAP and re-provisioned via the WLAN controller; firmware updated to v8.4.2.

title: System-wide database crash
description: It would be lovely if someone could take a look at the CRM when they have a spare moment. The entire company is currently unable to process any payments, but I know how busy you are, so no rush at all.
resolution: Restored database connection strings and restarted the application pool to bring the CRM back online.

title: Account disabled prematurely
description: My account was disabled this morning, but I am not leaving the company! Can you please check why? This is impacting my work.
resolution: Discovered an accidental trigger in the HR-to-AD synchronization tool and restored the account status.

title: Lost company laptop
description: I am so sorry to report this, but I left my work laptop in a taxi. It is definitely gone. I need to report this immediately so that no data is accessed.
resolution: Issued a remote wipe command to the device via MDM and revoked all certificates associated with the hardware identifier.

title: Can't login to Adobe CC
description: I'm signed in, but the apps (Photoshop and Illustrator) say I don't have a valid subscription on this machine. It worked yesterday on my Windows 10 desktop, but now it's acting up.
resolution: Logged the user out of all Adobe sessions and performed a fresh login to re-validate the license token.

title: WiFi intermittent on MacBook Pro
description: My WiFi keeps dropping in the conference room. It's really frustrating because I'm in back-to-back meetings. macOS Monterey, hardware ID 88:E9:FE.
resolution: Reset the network interface configuration and updated the wireless driver firmware.

title: Wireless card driver issue
description: My laptop is losing Wi-Fi connection constantly. The device manager says 'Intel Wi-Fi 6 AX200' has a code 10 error. I've restarted twice already.
resolution: Performed a clean uninstall of the wireless driver and installed the latest manufacturer version.

title: Can't access the database
description: I'm getting an 'Access Denied' error when trying to run my migration script. I definitely have the right password. My workstation is running Ubuntu 22.04.
resolution: Corrected LDAP group permissions mapping for the user's active directory account.

title: Guest Wi-Fi Down
description: The Guest_Wifi SSID is not broadcasting in the lobby. I checked the WAP-Lobby-01 unit and the status LED is blinking amber. Restarting the WAP via the controller didn't resolve the issue.
resolution: Factory reset the WAP and re-provisioned via the WLAN controller; firmware updated to v8.4.2.

title: Cannot map network drive S:
description: Ever since the OS update to macOS Sonoma 14.2, I can no longer mount the S: drive using SMB. I get an 'Operation not permitted' error when attempting to connect to the server share. Please help.

title: Application Deployment failure
description: Tried to install the new proprietary accounting software, but it hangs at 84% during the configuration stage. Error code: 1603. I have administrative rights on my laptop.
resolution: Removed leftover registry keys from a failed previous installation and ran the installer with full elevated privileges.

title: LUN masking visibility issue
description: We added a new Linux host to the fabric, but it cannot see the assigned LUNs. The Zoning is correct on the Brocade switches, but the storage array doesn't show the WWN of the HBA as logged in.
resolution: Corrected the zoning configuration by adding the missing WWN alias to the specific fabric zone.

title: TOTAL SYSTEM COLLAPSE IMMINENT
description: THE WIFI IN THE BREAKROOM IS LAGGING BY 20MS. WE ARE LOSING PRODUCTIVITY AT AN ALARMING RATE. IF THIS ISN'T FIXED IMMEDIATELY, THE ENTIRE OFFICE WILL BE PARALYZED!!!
resolution: Performed a standard access point reboot during scheduled maintenance hours.

title: SAP GUI performance issues
description: SAP GUI 7.70 is running incredibly slowly on my workstation today. Every time I hit enter after a transaction code, the hourglass spins for at least 30 seconds before loading. My colleagues are not seeing this issue. Is there a server-side lag?
resolution: Cleared the local SAP GUI trace files and increased the memory allocation settings in the connection configuration.

title: DHCP Scope Exhaustion
description: Devices on the Guest Wi-Fi are failing to pull an IP address. Logs show a 'No more addresses available' error in the DHCP server scope 10.50.20.x.
resolution: Expanded the DHCP scope range and reduced the lease time from 8 days to 4 hours to reclaim stale entries.

title: VPN Authentication Failure - Error 691
description: I keep getting Error 691 when trying to connect to the corporate VPN from my home network. I've double-checked my domain credentials and even performed a password reset via the self-service portal, but the issue persists. My machine is running Windows 11 Pro build 22621.
resolution: Reset the user's Active Directory account lockout status and cleared cached credentials in the Cisco AnyConnect client.

title: Lost my YubiKey
description: I managed to lose my hardware security key. How do I get a new one and remove the lost one from my account? I need to log in to get my work done.
resolution: Deactivated the lost hardware key in Okta and provided the user with a temporary bypass code until a replacement arrives.

title: Firmware update stuck
description: Tried updating the firmware on the core firewall to v9.16.2. The GUI is stuck on 'Updating - Do not turn off' for the last 4 hours. Is it safe to reboot?
resolution: Manually performed a hard reset via the console port after verifying the firmware file integrity; the firewall successfully rolled back to the stable v9.16.1 image.

title: Revoke access for offboarded employee
description: Effective immediately, please revoke all access for John Doe. We need his email disabled and his VPN credentials terminated. He is no longer with the company.
resolution: Disabled AD account, revoked O365 license, and wiped remote access permissions across all systems.

title: SSH timeout to dev server
description: I am formally reporting a persistent connectivity failure when attempting to initiate an SSH session with the staging server (10.0.50.22) from my local macOS Monterey environment. This issue, characterized by a 'Connection timed out' error, represents a regression from the previous day's successful access. Please investigate whether any recent modifications to firewall configurations have been implemented that would restrict this connection.
resolution: Added the user's current dynamic IP range to the whitelist on the perimeter firewall.

title: No WiFi in Conference Room 3B
description: Literally nobody can connect to the guest WiFi in the east wing. My phone shows 'No Internet Connection' even with a full signal. This is a huge issue since we have clients visiting today.
resolution: Identified a faulty PoE injector on the hallway access point and replaced the Cat6 patch cable.

title: Unable to access production database
description: Getting a 'Permission Denied (publickey)' error when trying to SSH into the PROD-DB-01 server. My key was rotated yesterday, and I suspect it wasn't pushed to the authorized_keys file on the target server.
resolution: Manually added the new public key to the authorized_keys file on the production database server and restarted the SSH daemon.

title: Network latency spike
description: We are experiencing significant packet loss on the VoIP phones. Users are reporting audio clipping. Investigating logs now.
resolution: Reconfigured QoS tags on the core switch to prioritize VoIP traffic over general web browsing.

title: Notion desktop app black screen
description: My Notion app just shows a black screen whenever I open it. I've tried reinstalling it twice, but nothing works. I need access to my notes for the meeting in 20 minutes.
resolution: Cleared the Notion cache directory located in %AppData% and performed a clean re-installation.

title: NTP Desync on DC01
description: Monitoring alerts are flagging a clock skew of over 500ms on our primary Domain Controller. This is triggering Kerberos authentication failures across the forest. Please investigate the external time source connectivity.
resolution: Updated W32Time configuration to point to internal stratum 1 NTP servers and forced a resync.

title: Can't save to USB drive
description: Ugh, my USB drive is write-protected. I didn't flip any switch on the hardware, and I definitely didn't lock it. I need to move these files for a meeting ASAP.
resolution: Removed the 'read-only' attribute from the disk using diskpart in the command prompt.

title: Application crash on startup
description: Every time I try to launch the Adobe Creative Cloud suite, it crashes immediately after the splash screen. I'm running Windows 11 on a Dell Precision workstation. The Event Viewer shows an error code 0xc0000005 in ntdll.dll.
resolution: Performed a clean reinstallation of the Creative Cloud desktop app and updated the GPU drivers to the latest WHQL release.

title: VPN gateway timeout
description: I'm having trouble connecting to the office via Cisco AnyConnect on Windows 11. It gets stuck at 40% and eventually says 'Connection Timed Out'. My home internet is fine.
resolution: Increased the session timeout threshold on the head-end firewall and cleared stale VPN sessions for the user ID.

title: SAN latency spikes on production cluster
description: We are observing intermittent I/O wait times exceeding 500ms on our Dell PowerStore array. This is impacting our SQL production database performance significantly. We see high latency alerts in the vCenter dashboard for all VMs hosted on the DataStore-01 LUN.
resolution: Identified a misconfigured replication schedule causing excessive IOPS; adjusted the schedule to off-peak hours.

title: EMERGENCY: Requesting new sticker
description: THE STORAGE CABINET IS COMPLETELY UNUSEABLE WITHOUT A LABEL! I AM LITERALLY SHAKING! PLEASE DROP EVERYTHING AND GET ME A Dymo LABEL MAKER RIGHT NOW OR WE WILL LOSE EVERYTHING!
resolution: Provided user with label maker. Cabinet status confirmed as fully operational.

title: Unable to connect to MySQL instance after password reset
description: Hi, I recently updated my database credentials for the dev environment and now I can't connect via MySQL Workbench 8.0 on my macOS Monterey machine. I keep getting an 'Access denied for user' error even though the credentials work in the CLI. Could you please double-check my permissions?
resolution: Verified the user account was locked due to multiple failed attempts; cleared the lockout and confirmed the user had the correct host-based access privileges.

title: Office Wi-Fi password not working
description: I am writing to formally report a persistent connectivity issue regarding my newly issued laptop and the 'Office_Secure' wireless network. Despite providing the correct credentials, the system repeatedly returns an 'Incorrect password' error, preventing me from establishing a connection. Please investigate this authentication failure and advise on the necessary steps to resolve the issue.
resolution: Removed the saved network profile on the laptop and re-authenticated using the user's domain credentials.

title: Salesforce login loop
description: I am writing to formally report a persistent technical issue preventing access to Salesforce. When attempting to log in via the Google Chrome browser on Windows 11, the application enters an infinite refresh loop, rendering the login page inaccessible. Despite performing standard troubleshooting procedures, including clearing the browser cache and cookies, the issue remains unresolved. This technical failure is currently preventing me from fulfilling my professional responsibilities, specifically regarding the mandatory updating of lead records. Please prioritize this request as it is significantly impacting my workflow.
resolution: Identified as a conflict with a recently pushed browser extension. Disabled the extension and forced a browser refresh.

title: Salesforce page load timeout
description: When I try to pull the quarterly report on Salesforce, the page hangs for about 30 seconds and then gives me an 'Error 504: Gateway Timeout'. I have tried clearing my cache on Chrome version 124.0.6367.60, but the issue persists. Can someone look into this? It is blocking my weekly submission.
resolution: Increased session timeout limits on the server-side configuration and cleared stale cached metadata for the user profile.

title: DNS resolution issues
description: Some internal hostnames are not resolving. I tried flushing the cache, but nslookup just times out. It seems random, sometimes it works, sometimes it doesn't.
resolution: Updated the forwarders on the primary DC; cleaned up a loop in the secondary DNS recursive lookup configuration.

title: Core Switch Uplink Flapping
description: Hey, heads up—we're getting intermittent drops on the main uplink (Te1/0/1) for the 9300 dist switch. It’s hitting ERR_DISABLE every 15-20 mins due to link flapping, which is causing latency spikes across the entire 3rd-floor VLAN.
resolution: Replaced the SFP+ transceiver and patched the fiber cable; port stability restored.

title: Deadlock detected during transaction
description: Transaction ID 0x4A21 encountered a deadlock while updating the inventory table. Error code 1213. This is happening multiple times an hour during our peak morning window.
resolution: Updated application logic to ensure consistent row-locking order across all concurrent transactions.

title: Ethernet port dead at desk 42
description: My computer says 'Network cable unplugged' even though it's connected. I tried swapping the patch cable with a known working one and still get the same error. Please send someone to check the wall jack.
resolution: Found a faulty patch panel port in the server room closet; repatched the user's connection to a different port on the switch.

title: Slow query performance
description: The 'GetOrders' stored procedure is taking over 30 seconds to execute on our staging environment. It used to take less than a second. We haven't changed any code recently.
resolution: Updated the outdated statistics on the Orders table which caused the query optimizer to choose a suboptimal execution plan.

title: Guest Wi-Fi portal not loading
description: The login page for the guest network just sits there spinning when customers try to connect. It says 'Redirecting...' and never goes anywhere.
resolution: Rebooted the wireless controller and cleared the captive portal cache, which was preventing new authentication sessions.

title: Zoom audio sync lag
description: I am beyond frustrated that the audio is constantly lagging behind the video during every single all-hands meeting. My network latency is perfectly fine, yet the Zoom desktop client insists on spiking my CPU usage to 90% every time I’m in a call. This is completely unacceptable and making it impossible to work.
resolution: Updated Zoom client to the latest version and adjusted audio device buffer settings in the application.

title: Slow directory enumeration
description: Browsing large file directories on the central server takes several minutes. The server CPU usage is low, but responsiveness is abysmal.
resolution: Optimized DNS round-robin settings and updated NIC drivers to improve path negotiation speed.

title: SERVER DOWN: EVERYTHING IS BROKEN HELP HELP HELP
description: I accidentally deleted a comment on a post from 2018. It's not a big deal, but can you please restore the whole server from a backup? I'm totally freaking out here.
resolution: Instructed user on how to use the 'Undo' feature in the application dashboard.

title: Slow internet speeds
description: The internet is incredibly slow today for the entire accounting team. Pages take forever to load, and our cloud-based accounting software keeps timing out. Is there a bandwidth cap active?
resolution: Identified a massive background OS update consuming 90% of the circuit bandwidth; implemented QoS policy to throttle Windows Update traffic.

title: Corrupt virtual disk file
description: Hey, SRV-APPS-01 isn't booting up. It’s throwing a 0x80070005 error when trying to hit the .vmdk on the datastore. Pretty sure the VMFS volume has some file system corruption.
resolution: Ran an 'fsck' equivalent check on the datastore and repaired the corrupted metadata header on the vmdk file.

title: Need access to production
description: Hey! Could you grant me read-only access to the production Postgres DB? Need it for some audit reports. My username is j.doe. Thanks!
resolution: Granted the 'reporting_role' to user j.doe and confirmed they can access the required views.

title: Help! The printer is making a weird noise
description: The warehouse printer is grinding loudly and printing blank pages. It's a Kyocera TASKalfa, and the screen says 'Error F248'. I need this fixed today so we can finish shipping.
resolution: Removed a jammed plastic label from the fuser unit and performed a drum cleaning cycle.

title: Degraded performance on bulk uploads
description: Bulk import jobs are failing halfway through. Could be a network buffer overflow or disk I/O wait on the database.
resolution: Expanded database transaction log storage to prevent disk-full stalls during large imports.

title: Guest WiFi login page not appearing
description: The redirect page for the guest WiFi isn't popping up on mobile devices. Users just get a 'connection not private' error. Please look into it.
resolution: Updated the SSL certificate on the captive portal gateway which had expired.

title: Lost Company Laptop
description: I left my company-issued MacBook Pro in a taxi this morning. I am panicking. Please wipe it remotely as soon as possible so my data doesn't get accessed.
resolution: Issued remote wipe command via MDM. Device marked as 'Stolen' in the asset management system and remote lock confirmed.

title: VPN connection dropping repeatedly
description: I'm having trouble staying connected to the corporate VPN while working from home. I am using GlobalProtect 5.2 on Windows 11, and it disconnects every 15-20 minutes with a 'Gateway timeout' error. This is making it impossible to access our internal SQL servers.
resolution: Updated GlobalProtect client to version 6.0 and cleared cached configuration files, which resolved the handshake timeout issue.

title: Teams camera not detected
description: My webcam works in every app except Microsoft Teams. It shows a black screen with a 'Camera not detected' error code 0x80070005. I've checked my privacy settings and the camera is enabled for Teams.
resolution: Updated webcam drivers via Device Manager and cleared the Teams cache directory.

title: Static IP conflict on workstation WS-042
description: I keep getting the Windows error 'An IP address conflict has occurred' on my machine. I need a static IP for the lab equipment software, but it seems like someone else is using it.
resolution: Identified a rogue device using the static IP. Assigned a new reserved IP in the DHCP range for the workstation and updated the lab software configuration.

title: Suspicious email signature
description: I received an email from an external sender that claims to be our CFO, but the signature looks weird and the reply-to address is a Gmail account. I haven't clicked anything, just wanted to report it.
resolution: Flagged the sender's domain as malicious in the spam filter and blocked all incoming mail from that specific address.

title: Help! Locked out of my laptop
description: My computer (LT-8892) is showing a BitLocker recovery screen after the Windows 11 update finished this morning. I've tried entering my PIN multiple times, but nothing happens. I'm stuck and can't start my work.
resolution: Retrieved BitLocker recovery key from Intune and successfully performed a boot override.

title: Can't access dev database
description: I'm trying to connect to the dev instance via pgAdmin on my MacBook Pro but it keeps saying 'Connection refused'. I verified the VPN is active. Is there a firewall change?
resolution: Whitelisted user's new dynamic IP address in the security group.

title: Cloud storage sync loop
description: The OneDrive client on my desktop is stuck in an endless sync loop. It keeps saying 'Processing changes' but never finishes, and it's killing my CPU usage. I've tried restarting the app but no luck.
resolution: Cleared the OneDrive cache folder and performed a soft reset of the synchronization engine using the /reset command.

title: VPN Authentication Failure - Error 691
description: I am unable to connect to the corporate VPN using Cisco AnyConnect 4.10 on my MacBook Pro running macOS Monterey. It keeps throwing 'Error 691: The remote connection was denied because the user name and password combination you provided is not recognized'. I have already verified my credentials via the web portal and they work fine.
resolution: Reset the user's LDAP password and forced a re-sync with the RADIUS server.

title: Mount point mounting failure
description: Several application servers are failing to mount their remote drives after a reboot. Troubleshooting has been unable to verify if it is an authentication (Network) or target availability (Storage) issue.
resolution: Corrected an incorrect VLAN tagging configuration on the switch port preventing storage-to-server traffic.

title: SSL/TLS handshake failure
description: Some of our legacy internal web apps are failing to load on modern browsers with a 'Your connection is not private' error. It seems like the server is still using TLS 1.0, which we blocked last week.
resolution: Updated the IIS configuration on the server to support TLS 1.2 and re-bound a SHA-256 certificate to the site.

title: Slack desktop app stuck on loading screen
description: Slack won't open. Just stays on the loading icon forever.
resolution: Cleared the Slack application cache folder located in %AppData%\Slack and performed a forced restart.

title: VPN connection failure
description: Ever since the latest Cisco AnyConnect update to version 4.10, I can't connect to the office VPN. It just says 'Unable to establish connection to the remote gateway'. It was working fine yesterday.

title: Application Deployment failure
description: Hey, having some trouble installing the new accounting software. It keeps hanging at 84% during configuration and throwing error 1603. I’ve already got admin rights, so not sure what's up—any ideas?
resolution: Removed leftover registry keys from a failed previous installation and ran the installer with full elevated privileges.

title: Security group cleanup
description: We have several users who have left the department and still have access to the 'Sensitive_HR_Data' share. Please remove their access immediately for compliance reasons.
resolution: Removed all listed users from the 'SEC_Sensitive_HR_Data' group and audited remaining members.

title: Excel 365 freezing with large datasets
description: Whenever I import CSV files larger than 50MB into Excel 365 on my MacBook Pro M2, the application freezes entirely and stops responding. Activity Monitor shows 'Not Responding' status under Microsoft Excel. I'm on macOS Sonoma 14.4. Please advise.

title: MAC address filtering issue
description: I just received a new Dell Latitude laptop and it won't connect to the secure office network. It shows an authentication error on the 802.1x login prompt.

title: Guest Wi-Fi portal not loading
description: People are complaining that they can connect to the Guest_WiFi just fine, but the splash page never actually loads. Everyone is stuck with a "No Internet" error and the connection just times out. This is completely broken and needs to be fixed immediately.

title: Switch port 12 down
description: Port 12 on the stack in IDF-02 is showing status err-disabled. The uplink to the AP in the lobby is down. Please investigate.

title: Need access to Finance-Shared-Drive
description: Hi, I just started on the accounting team and need read/write access to the Finance-Shared-Drive. My manager is CC'd on this ticket. Thanks!

description: I am writing to formally report persistent connectivity issues regarding the Guest_WiFi network within the breakroom. Despite maintaining a successful connection to the specified SSID, data throughput is severely throttled, rendering it impossible to load standard webpages. I request that this matter be investigated and resolved as a priority.
resolution: Identified a rogue access point causing co-channel interference on channel 6. Power-cycled the AP and set it to a static non-overlapping frequency.

title: Slow file access speeds
description: Is the SAN completely broken today? It is taking 30 seconds just to open basic PDF files from the shared drive, and it’s grinding my entire workflow to a halt. Fix this already.
resolution: Identified a misconfigured VLAN tag on the storage switch causing latency; corrected port settings and restored normal throughput.

title: Total data loss on USB flash drive
description: I accidentally formatted my 128GB flash drive while trying to create a Windows bootable media. Everything was on there, including my photos from last summer. Can you please get them back for me?!
resolution: Ran data recovery software on the formatted drive; successfully restored 95% of the files.

title: Cloud storage sync failure
description: My OneDrive client is stuck at 'Processing changes'. It's been like this for three days. I've already tried clearing the cache folder, but it didn't help.
resolution: Identified a file with an invalid character in the filename; removed the offending file and restarted the sync client.

title: NAS volume unmounted after power flicker
description: Our QNAP TS-453D NAS dropped the connection to the primary file share around 9:00 AM. The logs show a kernel panic error 0x80040154 when trying to remount the iSCSI target. All users are currently unable to access the \\NAS-PROD-01 volume.
resolution: Performed a hard reboot of the NAS controller and refreshed the iSCSI initiator session on the host server; volume mounted successfully.

title: Database login failed
description: I can't get into the database. It just says login failed. Please fix.
resolution: Reset the user's AD password and re-synced the permissions in the SQL management console.

title: NAS drive unreachable after firmware update
description: Our Synology DS1821+ is showing as disconnected in DSM after the latest firmware update to version 7.2.1. All status LEDs are blinking orange, and we cannot ping the static IP address from any workstation. Please investigate as this holds our department's primary backup repository.
resolution: Performed a hard reset of the network interface and manually rolled back the firmware version to the previous stable release via Synology Assistant.

title: Website blocked by firewall
description: I'm trying to access a research portal for my project, but the firewall is blocking it with a 'Category: Malware/Phishing' alert. This site is definitely safe and required for my work.
resolution: Whitelisted the specific URL in the web filter policy after verifying the site's reputation and security certificate.

title: Update on firewall rules
description: We need to whitelist the IP address 192.168.50.12 for our new API integration. It needs access to port 443. Could you please update the edge firewall rules?
resolution: Created new inbound NAT and firewall rule for the specified API server.

title: VPN connection failing
description: Cannot connect to the corporate network via GlobalProtect. It just says 'Authentication Failed' after I approve the Duo push notification. macOS Sonoma 14.2.
resolution: Updated the GlobalProtect client certificate on the user's device and cleared the cached SAML assertion in the browser.

title: Unexpected session termination
description: Active database sessions are dropping without error codes. Unclear if the idle timeout setting in the DB is active or if a NAT device is dropping the stateful connection.
resolution: Adjusted firewall TCP keep-alive settings to prevent premature connection reaping.

title: VMware datastore reaching capacity
description: Datastore 'Prod_SSD_02' is currently at 92% capacity. We need to expand this before we hit the hard limit and trigger VM snapshots failures. We have 2TB of unallocated space available on the array.
resolution: Expanded the VMFS datastore by extending the extent on the storage array and resizing the volume within vCenter.

title: Database connection denied
description: We are reporting a persistent authentication failure regarding the service account 'svc_app_db' when attempting to establish a connection to the Oracle 19c database. Despite rigorous verification confirming that the credentials stored within the vault are accurate and synchronized, the database consistently returns an 'ORA-01017: invalid username/password' error. This discrepancy suggests an unresolved issue within the database authentication layer and requires immediate investigation to restore service connectivity.
resolution: The password in the DB wallet was out of sync with the Vault. Updated the wallet credential store.

title: Slow upload speeds for video backups
description: My workstation is only getting 5Mbps upload speed when syncing to the cloud. I'm connected via gigabit Ethernet. Could the QoS policy be throttling my traffic?
resolution: Verified that the user’s traffic was being correctly classified in the high-priority queue; adjusted the bandwidth shaper settings to allow for increased cloud storage throughput.

title: User reporting missing files
description: I think I accidentally deleted a whole folder of project files from the file server. I can't find them in the Recycle Bin. Can you please check if there's a Shadow Copy available?
resolution: Restored the folder from the most recent Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) snapshot taken at 04:00 AM.

title: Cannot access root directory on Linux server
description: Running Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. I'm getting a 'Permission Denied' error when trying to sudo to /var/www/html/app. I'm sure I have the right group permissions set on the folder.
resolution: Corrected the user's group membership to 'www-data' and applied proper chown/chmod permissions to the directory.

title: Printer Queue Issues
description: The print server is hanging again. Every time someone sends a job to the HR_Printer_01, the spooler service stops. Error code 0x80040154.
resolution: Removed corrupted print driver and performed a clean install of the manufacturer's V4 universal print driver.

title: BitLocker recovery screen loop
description: My Latitude 5420 is stuck on the BitLocker recovery blue screen after a firmware update. I don't have the 48-digit recovery key. Please help me get back into my machine immediately as I have a presentation in 20 minutes.
resolution: Retrieved recovery key from Active Directory and assisted user in bypassing the boot loop to restore access.

title: VPN Authentication Failure - Error 691
description: I'm trying to connect to the corporate VPN from my home network using Cisco AnyConnect v4.10, but I keep getting Error 691: The remote connection was denied because the user name and password combination you provided is not recognized. I have already verified my credentials via the web portal and they work fine there. Please check if my account is locked in the RADIUS server.
resolution: Reset user's Active Directory account password and cleared stuck VPN session on the ASA firewall.

title: Outlook search not returning recent emails
description: My search bar in Outlook is not indexing emails sent after Tuesday. I've tried rebuilding the index, but it gets stuck at 4,000 items. Need help ASAP.
resolution: Performed a manual repair of the Outlook Data File (.ost) using the SCANPST.EXE utility.

title: Slow query on reporting dashboard
description: Hey, the dashboard is taking like 30 seconds to load the monthly sales report. It was fine yesterday, but now it's super laggy. Could you check if something is locked or if we need a new index?
resolution: Identified a missing index on the 'transaction_date' column. Ran an EXPLAIN ANALYZE, added the index, and query time dropped to 200ms.

title: Requesting sudo access
description: I am formally requesting the provisioning of sudo privileges on the development Linux servers running Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, as required for the execution of my current project responsibilities. Please be advised that this request has been formally reviewed and authorized by my direct manager; documentation of this approval is available via email correspondence upon request.
resolution: Denied: Internal policy requires senior approval for sudo access; escalated to Manager.

title: Unable to access VPN client
description: I am beyond frustrated at this point. My Cisco AnyConnect client is just hanging on "Connecting" indefinitely and refuses to actually log me in. I’ve already wasted time restarting my laptop twice and verifying my internet is working perfectly fine, but absolutely nothing has changed. I need access to the internal server to do my job—can someone please fix this immediately?
resolution: Flushed the local DNS cache and updated the Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client to the latest version compatible with the current network firmware.

title: OneNote sync error 0xE0000007
description: My notes are not syncing across my devices. My laptop is showing a sync error code 0xE0000007. I've signed out and signed back in, but it's still stuck.
resolution: Identified a corrupted page in a section. Moved the notes to a new section, deleted the corrupted one, and forced a manual sync.

title: Email client freezes when synchronizing large mailboxes
description: Outlook becomes unresponsive for several minutes periodically. Possible cause is synchronization delay or high latency to the mail server.
resolution: Reduced the local OST file size and disabled background indexing to prevent client-side hangs.

title: VPN connection failing - Error 807
description: My VPN keeps crashing when I try to log in from home. I keep getting Error 807 saying the network connection was interrupted. I'm using the Cisco AnyConnect client on my company laptop. It was working fine yesterday, but now it won't even connect to the gateway.
resolution: Cleared the local cached credentials and updated the AnyConnect client to version 4.10, which resolved the handshake timeout.

title: Cannot export reports in SAP
description: Hey, I'm trying to export the Q3 financial report to Excel from SAP GUI 7.70, but it just hangs indefinitely. I've tried restarting the app and my MacBook Pro, but no luck. It's really urgent.
resolution: Cleared the SAP GUI local cache and increased the memory allocation limits in the configuration settings.

title: Can't connect to video conference
description: I'm in a meeting right now and my Zoom call keeps freezing. My ping is spiking over 500ms. I'm connected via Wi-Fi in the conference room. This is urgent.
resolution: Advised user to move closer to the access point and disconnected personal mobile devices from the Wi-Fi to reduce bandwidth congestion.

title: OneDrive sync error
description: OneDrive is stuck on 'Processing changes' for three days now. It keeps giving me error code 0x8004de40. I’ve restarted multiple times and checked my internet connection.
resolution: Cleared the OneDrive cached credentials and performed a reset of the OneDrive sync client app.

title: Permission issues on DFS share
description: Some users can't access the marketing folder on the DFS namespace. They are getting 'Access Denied' despite having 'Read' permissions assigned. Server logs show Event ID 4625.
resolution: Corrected an inheritance issue on the parent folder security tab and updated the DFS referral targets.

title: Unknown USB device plugged in
description: I found a weird USB drive in the parking lot and plugged it into my workstation to see whose it was. Now my desktop icons are disappearing and the computer is very laggy. Should I be worried?
resolution: Isolated workstation from the network immediately. Re-imaged the machine from a clean state and initiated a mandatory security awareness training for the user.

title: Slow file transfer speeds to file server
description: File transfers to the central file server (FS-04) are crawling at about 2MB/s. This is across both wired and wireless connections in the marketing department. It makes working on high-res video files impossible.
resolution: Detected a duplex mismatch on the office switch port; forced to 1Gbps full-duplex.

title: Adobe Creative Cloud License missing
