description: I updated my Creative Cloud app on my Mac and now it says my trial has expired. I have a paid company subscription. Help?
resolution: Re-assigned Adobe CC license in the Admin Console and forced a sign-out/sign-in refresh on the local client.

title: Performance degradation on Oracle 19c
description: Queries that normally take milliseconds are taking over 30 seconds since the patch applied last night. We are seeing high wait events for 'db file sequential read'. Please investigate ASAP.
resolution: Recompiled invalid objects and gathered fresh statistics on the affected tables, which restored normal query execution times.

title: Slack desktop notifications not appearing
description: Slack desktop app on my ThinkPad E15 stopped showing notifications. I checked system settings, and 'Do Not Disturb' is off. It's annoying because I keep missing client messages.
resolution: Reset the Slack application data via the Help menu and re-granted notification permissions in Windows Settings.

title: Printer connectivity issues
description: The printer in Marketing is offline. It says 'IP Address Conflict' on the display. Can someone take a look? Nobody can print their reports.
resolution: Updated the printer to a static IP address outside of the DHCP range and flushed the ARP cache on the local gateway.

title: UPS Battery Fault Alert
description: Received an automated SNMP trap from the server room UPS (APC Smart-UPS 3000). The unit is reporting a 'Battery Replace Required' status. No power loss yet, but we need to act before it dies.
resolution: Scheduled a maintenance window to swap out the aging battery cartridge; system diagnostics now pass all integrity checks.

title: DNS resolution failing for internal domains
description: I can ping external sites like 8.8.8.8, but I cannot resolve our internal intranet URL. Browser shows DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN. This is blocking my work.
resolution: Corrected the primary DNS server settings on the local DHCP scope.

title: Unable to run PowerShell scripts as admin
description: My machine (WS-DESK-99) won't let me execute scripts due to execution policy restrictions. I tried running 'Set-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned' but it says access is denied. I need this to finish my testing.
resolution: Granted temporary local administrator rights to user to update the execution policy for their development environment.

title: Corrupt virtual disk file
description: Our VM 'SRV-APPS-01' will not boot. It throws error 0x80070005 when trying to access the .vmdk file on the datastore. I think the file system on the VMFS volume might be corrupted.
resolution: Ran an 'fsck' equivalent check on the datastore and repaired the corrupted metadata header on the vmdk file.

title: USB drive blocked by Endpoint Protection
description: Hey, I tried plugging in my personal thumb drive to transfer a report and your software immediately nuked it. It gave me error code 0x80070005. Can you just whitelist it for five minutes?
resolution: Denied request per corporate data leakage prevention policy; recommended use of secure OneDrive file sharing.

title: Workstation showing strange network activity
description: My machine (WS-FIN-042) has been sluggish all morning. Running netstat -ano, I see an established connection to a suspicious external IP on port 4444. Task Manager shows high disk I/O from a process named 'svchost.exe' that isn't running from the System32 folder.
resolution: Isolated machine from the VLAN, identified malware beaconing, and initiated full disk wipe and OS re-image.

title: USB drive blocked by endpoint policy
description: Getting an 'Access Denied' error when trying to plug in my SanDisk USB drive to my Dell Latitude 5420. I need this to transfer some project files for the client meeting in an hour. Can you whitelist this specific hardware ID?
resolution: Identified hardware ID via EDR logs and created a temporary device control policy exception.

title: Forgot my RSA token
description: I'm working from home today and left my physical RSA key on my desk in the office. I need access to the VPN to finish the month-end close. Can you bypass the token requirement for just a few hours?
resolution: Verified identity via manager and implemented temporary MFA bypass via mobile push notification.

title: Intermittent Wi-Fi drops in Building 4
description: Users in the east wing of Building 4 are reporting frequent Wi-Fi disconnects on both Windows 10 and macOS Monterey devices. Signal strength fluctuates between full bars and zero every 15-20 minutes. We suspect a potential channel overlap with the neighboring office's APs.
resolution: Performed a site survey and adjusted the 5GHz channel settings on AP-B4-03 to mitigate interference.

title: Office network totally down
description: Everything is down. No internet, no server access, nothing. We have a deadline in two hours. Please fix this now!
resolution: Replaced the failed redundant power supply on the primary core router and rebooted the gateway.

title: Redis Cache Eviction issues
description: Our Redis cache (v6.2) is evicting keys way too aggressively despite having memory set to 16GB. We are seeing frequent cache misses that are putting unnecessary load back onto the primary SQL database. Please check the 'maxmemory-policy' setting.
resolution: Changed the eviction policy from 'allkeys-lru' to 'volatile-lru' to preserve important persistent data.

title: Volume expansion failed
description: I tried to extend the ZFS pool, but it returned 'error: pool is busy'. I am currently on Ubuntu 22.04 and I really need this extra space for the render farm.
resolution: Stopped the competing backup process that was locking the pool and successfully performed the 'zpool online -e' command.

title: Core Switch Uplink Failure
description: The primary uplink on CORE-SW-01 (Cisco Catalyst 9500) has dropped to a down/down state after a brief power fluctuation. Interface Gi1/0/48 is showing 'err-disable' with a cause of 'link-flap'. Please investigate the SFP module or the fiber run to the MDF.
resolution: Replaced faulty SFP+ transceiver and cleared err-disable state on the interface; link status restored to up.

title: Duplicate file cleanup
description: Our file server is getting cluttered with duplicate documents. Could IT run a script to identify and remove duplicates to free up space?
resolution: Ran a deduplication analysis report and scheduled a clean-up task for the weekend.

title: Cannot reach printer on VLAN 20
description: The accounting team can't print to the Xerox VersaLink B7030. I suspect an ACL change might be blocking traffic across the subnets. Can you check if the routes are still propagated correctly?
resolution: Corrected an incorrect ACL entry on the core switch that was inadvertently restricting port 9100 traffic between VLAN 10 and VLAN 20.

title: Issue with Outlook search
description: I am writing to formally report a persistent malfunction regarding the search functionality within Outlook 365. As of Tuesday, the application has failed to index or retrieve any incoming or outgoing correspondence. Furthermore, the search feature remains unresponsive and stuck in a continuous loading state. Please investigate this technical failure and provide a resolution at your earliest convenience.
resolution: Rebuilt the Windows Search Index for Outlook data files.

title: Notion desktop app black screen
description: My Notion app is completely useless—it’s just a blank black screen every time I open it. I’ve already wasted my time reinstalling the damn thing twice and it’s still broken. I have a meeting in 20 minutes and I need my notes immediately; fix this now.
resolution: Cleared the Notion cache directory located in %AppData% and performed a clean re-installation.

title: Root certificate expired
description: All our internal web applications are showing 'Your connection is not private' (NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID). It's happening on every machine in the marketing department.
resolution: Pushed the updated Root CA certificate to the workstations via Group Policy update (gpupdate /force) and flushed local DNS caches.

title: Firewall Policy Issue
description: The application team is unable to reach the API server on port 8443. I checked the Palo Alto logs and see 'policy-deny' for the source subnet. Please whitelist the server IP 10.50.2.15.
resolution: Updated Security Policy 'ALLOW_API_TRAFFIC' to include source subnet 10.50.2.0/24; tested and confirmed connectivity.

title: THE SERVER ROOM IS ON FIRE AND PEOPLE ARE SCREAMING
description: Can someone please reset my password? It’s just been a really stressful day and I can’t log into my email.
resolution: Reset user password for O365 account.

title: Reporting Query Failing
description: Every time I run the 'Monthly Sales Report' in PowerBI, it fails with a generic 'Internal Error' message. I am connected via the standard ODC driver. This worked fine last month, so I don't know what changed.
resolution: Increased the session memory limit for the reporting user profile, as the query volume had grown beyond the default buffer size.

title: Disk space alert on DB-Cluster-04
description: My monitoring is absolutely blowing up every 5 minutes because the /var/lib/mysql partition on DB-Cluster-04 is sitting at 98% capacity. I’ve already flagged this, and if you don't do something immediately before it hits 100%, the entire cluster is going to crash. Fix this now.
resolution: Purged archived transaction logs older than 30 days and extended the LVM volume on the host server.

title: SanDisk SSD failing SMART tests
description: My workstation, WS-FIN-04, started showing 'Hard drive failure imminent' warnings during boot this morning. CrystalDiskInfo reports reallocated sector count is critical. I've backed up my desktop files, but I need a replacement drive ASAP so I can finish month-end processing.
resolution: Replaced the failing 500GB SSD with a new NVMe drive and restored the user's OS image from the weekly backup.

title: VS Code debugger failing
description: Trying to run the debugger in VS Code version 1.85.1 but it instantly terminates with 'exit code 3221225477'. I've checked my launch.json file and everything looks correct.
resolution: Found a corrupted node_modules folder; deleted the folder and re-ran 'npm install' to resolve missing dependency errors.

title: Need sudo access for software installation
description: Hey! I’m working on a project that needs Wireshark and some specific network drivers, but my current user profile on this M2 MacBook doesn't have the admin permissions to install them. Could you hook me up with sudo access for this session?
resolution: Denied direct sudo access per security policy. Provided elevated access via self-service portal for approved software packages only.

title: Outlook search not returning results
description: Search in Outlook is completely broken. It says 'No results found' for emails I can clearly see in my inbox. Running Windows 10, version 22H2.
resolution: Rebuilt the Windows Search Index for Outlook data files.

title: Switch configuration lost after power outage
description: After the storm last night, the edge switch in the warehouse failed to reload its configuration. It reverted to factory defaults. We have no connectivity in that wing.
resolution: Restored the latest configuration backup via TFTP and saved the running-config to startup-config to ensure persistence.

title: Suspicious web traffic alerts
description: Firewall logs show that user workstation WS-112 is hitting known C2 (Command and Control) server domains. The traffic pattern suggests beaconing behavior occurring every 5 minutes. Please investigate this machine.
resolution: Deep packet inspection confirmed malicious behavior. Machine was seized for forensic analysis and user account credentials were reset as a precaution.

title: Query failing with syntax error
description: I am trying to run a simple join but getting a 'Syntax error near )' message. I'm using SQL Server Management Studio. Here is the query: SELECT * FROM Users INNER JOIN Roles ON Users.id = Roles.user_id)
resolution: Removed the trailing parenthesis causing the syntax error and provided the user with a formatted version of the query.

title: Adobe Acrobat Pro crashing on launch
description: My Acrobat Pro keeps crashing the second I open a PDF. I am running Windows 11 and this started after the latest Creative Cloud update. Event Viewer shows faulting module name: ntdll.dll.
resolution: Performed a clean reinstall of Adobe Acrobat and disabled hardware acceleration settings.

title: Ethernet port dead on workstation 402
description: My workstation doesn't show any lights on the NIC port. I have swapped the Cat6 cable with a known good one and tried a different wall jack, but I still have no link status on my HP EliteDesk.
resolution: Traced the wall jack to a faulty port on the Cisco Catalyst switch; moved the patch cable to a different, active switch port.

title: PostgreSQL replication lag
description: The read-replica in the AWS us-east-1 region is lagging by over 5 minutes behind the primary node. We are running Postgres 13. System load is normal, but replication slots are showing large WAL accumulation. This is causing data inconsistency for our reporting dashboard.
resolution: Cleared the orphaned replication slot and restarted the WAL sender process to sync the replica.

title: Volume mount point issue
description: The volume mounted at D:\Shares is not visible in File Explorer. Disk Management shows the volume as 'Offline' due to a policy conflict. Please resolve.
resolution: Changed the SAN policy from 'Offline Shared' to 'Online' using the Diskpart utility on the host.

title: Cannot export reports in PowerBI
description: I keep getting a 'Generic OLEDB error' when trying to export a report to PDF. I'm using the latest PowerBI desktop version. I need this fixed ASAP as the board meeting is in an hour.
resolution: Updated the OLEDB drivers and verified permissions on the target network drive destination.

title: VPN gateway timeout
description: Hey, whenever I try to connect to the corporate VPN using AnyConnect on Windows 11, it just hangs at 40% and eventually says 'The service provider was unreachable'. I've tried rebooting my laptop and resetting my Wi-Fi, but nothing changes. Please help.
resolution: Reset user's profile on the RADIUS server and cleared cached certificates on the client machine.

title: Application total lockout
description: It’s a bit inconvenient that the ERP system is throwing a 'Fatal Error 500' for every user in the building. I’m sure it’s just a minor glitch, but if someone could investigate, that would be wonderful.
resolution: Deployed a patch to fix the memory leak causing the ERP service to hang.

title: Disk Latency on SAN
description: VMs hosted on LUN_03 are experiencing extreme latency during peak hours. The storage array dashboard indicates IOPS are hitting the ceiling. We need to move some workloads.
resolution: Migrated high-IOPS database VMs to the SSD-tier storage pool to alleviate bottleneck.

title: External drive not mounting
description: My 2TB Seagate drive is completely invisible on my MacBook Pro running Sonoma and I am beyond frustrated. I’ve wasted time swapping out every USB-C cable and testing every single port on this machine, and the drive still won't show up in Finder. I have a critical meeting this afternoon and I absolutely need the files on that drive. Fix this now.
resolution: Used Disk Utility to identify the partition map corruption and ran 'fsck_exfat' in Terminal to repair the file system structure.

title: Need access to Shared Drive HR_Dept
description: Hi, I just started in the HR department today and I need access to the HR_Dept shared drive on the file server. My manager is Sarah Jenkins, if you need to verify this request. Thanks!
resolution: Verified approval from manager and granted read/write NTFS permissions to the user account.

title: Issue with MFA prompt
description: Hey, I’m having some trouble with the Authenticator app on my iPhone 15—it’s not popping up with the push notifications for M365 logins. I’ve already tried restarting my phone and reinstalling the app, but still no luck. Any ideas?
resolution: Removed the device from the user's MFA settings in Azure AD and prompted for a re-enrollment flow.

title: Jira dashboard widgets failing to load
description: Most of the widgets on my Jira dashboard are showing a 504 Gateway Timeout error. My team relies on these for sprint tracking. Is there a server-side issue?
resolution: Identified a stale browser cache issue; cleared cookies and cache for the Jira domain, which restored functionality.

title: Critical Error in AutoCAD
description: Fatal error during dwg file save operation: Unhandled Access Violation Reading 0x0000 Exception at 7ff81230h. This is happening on my primary workstation and I cannot lose this drawing. Please help immediately.
resolution: Recovered the file from the .bak backup folder and ran a RECOVER command on the corrupted .dwg file to repair the database.

title: Database connection error in custom app
description: The internal Inventory Management System is throwing a 500 error whenever we try to update stock. The log says 'Connection pool exhausted'. Please investigate, we have shipments going out today.
resolution: Increased the maximum connection pool size in the application's configuration file and killed zombie processes on the SQL server.

title: Request to whitelist a new software tool
description: Hey, I need to use this new automation script tool for my project. The security software is blocking it from running on my Linux machine (Ubuntu 22.04). Can you please whitelist it?
resolution: Reviewed the binary's hash and source origin. Added an exclusion rule for the specific file path in the endpoint security console.

title: SSD failure on workstation
description: My computer blue-screened with a 'CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED' error. Upon reboot, the BIOS is not detecting the Samsung 980 Pro NVMe drive. I have critical client files on there that aren't backed up.
resolution: SSD controller failed. Replaced drive under warranty and performed data recovery on the damaged NAND flash.

title: Production DB Connection Timeouts
description: Our application nodes (App-01 through App-05) are consistently failing to connect to the primary RDS instance (db-prod-01) with 'SQLState 08001: Unable to connect'. This started occurring at 03:15 AM EST after the scheduled maintenance window. We are seeing a spike in active connections reaching the max_connections limit.
resolution: Increased max_connections parameter in the DB parameter group and cleared orphaned sessions blocking the connection pool.

title: Guest Wi-Fi showing 'Connected, no internet'
description: We have constant complaints from visitors who can connect to the Guest network but never get the splash page. They are just stuck on "Connected, no internet" indefinitely. This is completely unacceptable and makes us look like amateurs. Please fix this immediately.
resolution: The Captive Portal service had stalled on the firewall appliance; restarted the service and cleared the active session table.

title: Zoom audio failure
description: Zoom isn't picking up my headset mic. The device is selected in the Zoom audio settings, but the input level bar doesn't move when I speak. Working on a Dell Latitude 5420.
resolution: Updated the Realtek audio driver and granted microphone permissions in Windows Privacy settings.

title: Slow query on reporting dashboard
description: I am writing to formally report a significant degradation in performance regarding the monthly sales report dashboard. While the system functioned within acceptable parameters yesterday, current load times have increased to approximately 30 seconds. Please investigate this latency issue, specifically checking for potential database locks or the need for additional indexing to restore optimal functionality.
resolution: Identified a missing index on the 'transaction_date' column. Ran an EXPLAIN ANALYZE, added the index, and query time dropped to 200ms.

title: Unable to map network drive
description: I am trying to map Z: to our internal file server, but it keeps asking for credentials even though I'm on the corporate network. When I enter my password, it just says 'Multiple connections to a server or shared resource by the same user are not allowed'.
resolution: Used 'net use * /delete' to clear existing persistent connections and re-established the drive mapping using the fully qualified domain name.

title: Database performance extremely slow after patch
description: Ever since the OS patches were applied to the Oracle 19c database server on RHEL 8 last night, the application latency has spiked by 400%. The IO wait times are through the roof. This is affecting all users in the EMEA region and we need this looked at immediately.
resolution: Identified a misconfiguration in the transparent huge pages settings post-patch; reverted to optimal kernel parameters.

title: Static IP conflict
description: We are getting alerts on the network management system regarding an IP conflict for 192.168.1.50. Two devices appear to be fighting over the same address. Please help identify them.
resolution: Identified a rogue wireless router plugged into a wall jack by a user; disabled the port and confiscated the device.

title: Request for Jira project access
description: Hey team, could you bump my permissions for the Project-X Jira board to developer access? I’m currently stuck in read-only and need to update my task statuses. Thanks!
resolution: Added user to the 'Dev-Team-Alpha' role within the Jira project permission scheme.

title: Office Wi-Fi password not working
description: I just got a new laptop and I'm trying to connect to the 'Office_Secure' network. It keeps saying 'Incorrect password' even though I know I'm typing it right. What's going on?
resolution: Removed the saved network profile on the laptop and re-authenticated using the user's domain credentials.

title: Minor flickering of server room lights
description: The overhead lights in the server room have been flickering for a few minutes. Not a big deal, but thought I would mention it whenever someone has a spare moment.
resolution: Dispatched electrical contractor to fix a faulty power phase causing voltage instability to the rack PDUs.

title: Physical security breach
description: I witnessed someone tailgating into the secure server room area without scanning their badge. I don't know who it was, but they were wearing a vendor visitor badge.
resolution: Reviewed security camera footage and confirmed the vendor was escorted by authorized personnel; noted for security awareness training.

title: Account lockout on domain controller
description: My domain account is repeatedly locking out every 15 minutes. Event Viewer on my Windows 10 workstation shows Event ID 4740, but I haven't entered any incorrect passwords. I suspect a cached credential issue on a background service.
resolution: Cleared stale credentials from Windows Credential Manager and updated the password for the mapped network drive service.

title: Password reset keeps failing
description: I'm trying to reset my password using the self-service portal, but the security questions are not appearing. I've tried clearing my browser cache and using an InPrivate window. Help!
resolution: Manually triggered a password reset link and updated the user's secondary recovery email in the system.

title: Unauthorized USB device detection
description: Endpoint protection triggered an alert for an unauthorized mass storage device plugged into the workstation in the accounting office. The device was removed, but we need to ensure no data exfiltration occurred.
resolution: Reviewed USB logs and confirmed no files were copied. Applied GPO to block non-approved hardware IDs.

title: Missing plugin in AutoCAD
description: My civil engineering plugin is missing from the toolbar after the latest update to AutoCAD 2024. I have a major deadline in two hours and I can't export my files without it. Frustrated that these updates always break my setup.
resolution: Re-registered the plugin DLL in the AutoCAD registry and verified file paths in the AppData directory.

title: Application sluggishness for remote workers
description: The web application is fast in the office but unusable from VPN. Difficult to distinguish between poor VPN bandwidth and application design flaws.
resolution: Implemented split-tunneling on the VPN to reduce latency for the application's traffic.

title: Strange sign-in activity
description: I received an alert that my account was signed into from a location in a different country. I am currently in the office in Chicago. I have already changed my password, but please check my recent session logs.
resolution: Terminated all active sessions globally and reviewed sign-in logs, confirming it was a false positive triggered by a VPN exit node change.

title: Onboarding Request - New Hire
description: We have a new developer joining the team on Monday. Please create their AD account, assign them to the 'Dev-Read-Only' group, and grant them access to the internal Git repository and Confluence wiki.
resolution: Created AD account and added the user to the requested security groups and application repositories.

title: User account termination
description: Please terminate access for John Doe immediately. Effective as of 5:00 PM today.
resolution: Disabled the user's AD account, revoked all O365 session tokens, and disabled their VPN access.

title: USB drive blocked
description: I need to move some files to a thumb drive for a client meeting, but the system is blocking it. It keeps saying 'Device access restricted by organization policy'. This is really slowing me down.
resolution: Explained data loss prevention (DLP) policy; provided encrypted, IT-approved hardware for the transfer.

title: Access Denied on project folder
description: I can't access the 'Marketing_Media' folder on the fileserver anymore. It keeps saying 'Access Denied' even though I've had access for months. Did something change with the permissions?
resolution: Found the user had been moved to a different Active Directory security group; restored membership to the correct file access group.

title: UPS Battery Fault - Server Room B
description: The APC Smart-UPS 3000VA unit in Rack 4 is beeping constantly and displaying a 'Replace Battery' (Error Code: F02) status on the LCD panel. We need someone to swap these units before the next scheduled maintenance window tomorrow.
resolution: Technician arrived on-site and performed a hot-swap of the RBC55 battery cartridge.

title: Need more space on my local drive
description: Hey guys, my laptop is full and I can't update Windows. Is there any way you can delete some old temp files or something for me?
resolution: Ran Disk Cleanup and removed 12GB of cache files; advised user to use cloud storage for large media files.

title: Missing Excel Add-in
description: The custom company financial add-in disappeared after the Office update this morning. I really need this to finish the quarterly budget. Can you please check if it was disabled?
resolution: Re-enabled the COM Add-in via the Excel Options menu and updated the registry keys for Trusted Locations.

title: MAYDAY MAYDAY EVERYTHING IS GONE
description: I cannot find my favorite stapler on my desk. Please escalate this to the Infrastructure lead immediately, this is an infrastructure crisis regarding my workspace organization.
resolution: Located stapler in the supply closet; redirected user to office supplies procurement.

title: I AM GOING TO LOSE MY MIND, EVERYTHING IS RUINED
description: My browser history is showing a popup from three weeks ago. I need this cleared right now before I lose my job, this is a total security disaster!
resolution: Cleared browser cache and cookies.

title: Guest Wi-Fi portal not loading
description: Users are reporting that they can connect to the 'Guest_WiFi' SSID but the splash page never appears. Devices just say 'No Internet' and time out.
resolution: Restarted the WLC (Wireless LAN Controller) service and cleared stale sessions from the guest VLAN.

title: Possible unauthorized login
description: I am formally reporting a suspicious sign-in event involving my Microsoft 365 account, originating from an IP address located in a region I am not currently visiting. Although I have proactively updated my account credentials, I remain concerned regarding the potential persistence of unauthorized active sessions and request a comprehensive review to ensure my account security has been fully restored.
resolution: Revoked all active OAuth tokens and forced a global logout across all devices.

title: Salesforce login loop on Chrome
description: I'm stuck in a login loop whenever I try to access Salesforce via Chrome 124.0 on Windows 11. It asks for my 2FA, redirects to the dashboard, and then immediately kicks me back to the login page. I've cleared my browser cache and cookies, but the issue persists.
resolution: Resolved by clearing site-specific data for Salesforce and resetting the user's Chrome sync profile to remove corrupted session tokens.

title: Critical vulnerability patch needed
description: My workstation has been flagged by the security department for utilizing an outdated version of Java. Due to current system restrictions, I lack the requisite local administrative privileges to perform the necessary update independently. I request that the IT department proceed with the mandatory update at your earliest convenience to ensure compliance with organizational security protocols.
resolution: Pushed the Java 8 update 401 via SCCM to the user's workstation.

title: Brute force attempts observed
description: Our external-facing web server is seeing a massive spike in SSH login attempts from various foreign IPs. Logs show thousands of failed authentication attempts in the last hour. We need to lock this down immediately.
resolution: Configured Fail2Ban to block offending IP ranges and restricted SSH access to our office VPN subnet.

title: ERP System throwing 500 internal server error
description: Our ERP web portal is throwing a 500 error for all users when trying to access the 'Inventory' module. We cannot fulfill orders. This is a total blocker.
resolution: Identified a memory leak on the application server and restarted the IIS worker process for the ERP site.

title: Account locked out again!
description: For the third time today, my domain account is locking me out again the second I try to sign into WS-IT-042. I am doing exactly what I do every other day, so I have no idea why this is suddenly a problem. I have a client demo in 20 minutes, so get this fixed right now—I cannot afford any more downtime.
resolution: Identified a stale credential in Windows Credential Manager related to a mapped drive; cleared stored credentials and reset AD account.

title: ORA-00600 internal error during nightly batch
description: While running our nightly ETL process on Oracle 19c (RHEL 8.4), the background job died with an ORA-00600: internal error code. Trace files indicate a corruption in the UNDO tablespace during a heavy update operation. This has delayed our morning data refresh significantly.
resolution: Performed a block media recovery and rebuilt the corrupted UNDO tablespace segments.

title: Stuck process in PostgreSQL
description: I have a 'VACUUM ANALYZE' process that has been running for 6 hours. Usually, this finishes in 20 minutes. It's on a PostgreSQL 14 instance running on RHEL 8.
resolution: Terminated a hung backend process that was holding an AccessExclusiveLock on the target table, allowing the vacuum to proceed.

title: Production DB Connection Timeouts
description: Our main web application is throwing 'java.sql.SQLTransientConnectionException: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available' errors intermittently. We are running PostgreSQL 14 on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. The load balancer shows CPU usage is low, but the database connection pool is maxed out.
resolution: Increased the max_connections setting in postgresql.conf and tuned the connection pool timeout parameters.

title: Connection refused in Java app
description: Our Java application on node-04 is throwing 'Connection Refused' (java.net.ConnectException). We verified the firewall ports are open on the DB server, but netstat shows nothing listening on 3306.
resolution: Restarted the database service which had hung after a kernel update.

title: VLAN tagging mismatch
description: After the recent firmware update on the edge switches, the printers on VLAN 20 are not reachable from the workstations on VLAN 10. Looks like the inter-VLAN routing is failing. Please look into the switch trunk configuration.
resolution: Corrected trunk port allowed-VLAN list to include missing VLAN 20 ID.

title: Database audit failure
description: The audit logs show a series of failed login attempts from an unknown internal IP address on the finance production database. The error code is 18456. We need to investigate if this is a potential security breach or a misconfigured service account.
resolution: Traced the IP to a legacy server in the HVAC department that was incorrectly mapped to the finance DB server; reconfigured the legacy app settings.

title: Restore request for user 'jsmith'
description: Hi, I accidentally deleted the 'config_settings' table in the staging database on 'Dev-DB-02'. Could you please restore this from last night's backup? I am currently unable to test the new features.
resolution: Restored the 'config_settings' table from the 02:00 AM full backup to a temporary schema for the user to export their data.

title: VPN Authentication Failure - Error 691
description: I'm trying to connect to the corporate VPN from my Windows 11 laptop, but I keep receiving Error 691. I've verified my AD password is correct and I am not locked out of my email. This started immediately after the latest OS patch this morning.
resolution: Reset the user's VPN profile in the gateway and cleared local cached credentials on the client machine.

title: VPN Authentication Failure - Error 691
description: Hey, I’m having some trouble getting onto the corporate VPN on my MacBook (running macOS Sonoma). I keep getting an "Error 691" saying my credentials aren't recognized. I know my AD password is correct because I can log into the Outlook web portal with the same ones, so I’m not sure what's up. Could someone take a look?
resolution: Reset the user's AD password sync in the Identity Provider portal and cleared the cached VPN credentials in the Keychain Access utility.

title: Unable to access internal Wiki
description: I keep getting a 401 Unauthorized error when visiting the Confluence internal site. I’ve cleared my browser cache and cookies, but the issue persists.
resolution: User account was present in the system but had an expired session token. Cleared the active session in the database.

title: VOIP phones showing 'No Service'
description: All 12 phones in the call center just lost connection at the same time. They are all cycling through 'Configuring...' and then showing 'No Service'. This is a disaster for our call volume.
resolution: Restarted the voice VLAN voice-gateway service which had hung after a firmware update.

title: Docker Desktop failing to start
description: Docker won't start on my machine after a kernel update. It gives an error regarding WSL2 integration. My current WSL version is 2.0.1.0.
resolution: Updated the WSL2 kernel component and enabled virtualization features in the BIOS as they were reset by the firmware update.

title: Help! Server room smells like ozone
description: I just walked into the server room and there is a faint burning smell near the rack containing the main database servers. I'm worried something is about to blow. Please send someone immediately.
resolution: Discovered a failed cooling fan in the secondary power supply of the R740 server; replaced the PSU unit and cleared the hardware alarm.

title: Requesting export of user data
description: I need a CSV export of all users registered between Jan 1st and Feb 28th. Please exclude inactive accounts. I'll need this by EOD for the marketing team.
resolution: Executed a T-SQL script to extract the data and uploaded it to the secure SFTP site.

title: Database login failing for new hire
description: My new dev, Sarah, can't access the development SQL database. She has the same credentials as the rest of the team, but gets an 'Authentication failed' error. We are using Active Directory for authentication.
resolution: Added the user to the appropriate AD security group that grants login access to the database server.

title: Slack desktop notifications not appearing
description: Slack desktop app on macOS is not showing any notifications, even though 'Do Not Disturb' is off. I checked system settings, and notifications are enabled for Slack. It's annoying because I keep missing messages from my manager.
resolution: Reset the Slack app data via the 'Help > Troubleshooting' menu and re-authorized system notification permissions.

title: Application crashing on startup
description: Our accounting software, Sage 50, stopped opening after the latest Symantec Endpoint Protection update. Event Viewer shows error 0xc0000005 related to a memory access violation. It seems the AV is sandboxing the executable.
resolution: Added the application directory to the Symantec exclusion list and performed a repair installation.

title: Need access to the Marketing shared drive
description: I’ve been waiting forever for access to the 'Marketing_Assets' folder. My team lead already approved this, so I don't understand why I’m still blocked. Can you please just add me already?
resolution: Added user to the AD security group 'GRP_Marketing_Read_Access' as requested.

title: MFA prompt loop
description: Hey, my Microsoft Authenticator app is stuck in a loop when I try to sign into Outlook. It asks for the number code, I enter it, and it just cycles back to the prompt. This is driving me crazy.
resolution: Removed the user's MFA device from the portal and walked them through re-registering their smartphone via QR code.

title: Error 504 Gateway Timeout on reporting tool
description: Running the month-end report results in a 504 error. Could be a server timeout or a network proxy intercepting the long request.
resolution: Increased the execution time limit in the application configuration to accommodate long-running SQL queries.

title: Antivirus alert on server SRV-04
description: CrowdStrike Falcon just flagged a suspicious process on SRV-04. The process is running out of Temp folders and is attempting to execute a PowerShell script with encoded parameters. I have isolated the server from the network to prevent lateral movement.
resolution: Identified malicious script as a false positive from a legitimate internal deployment tool and restored service.

title: Need access to the Marketing Share Drive
description: Hey! Just moved over from Sales and need access to the M:\Marketing folder. I can see the drive, but I'm getting an "Access Denied" error when I try to open it. Could you help me get that sorted?
resolution: Added user to the 'Marketing-Read-Write' Active Directory security group and requested a log-off/log-on.

title: Standard maintenance inquiry
description: The primary database server is physically on fire. I've evacuated the building. Just wanted to let you know so we can reschedule our meeting later today.
resolution: Triggered failover to secondary datacenter and alerted emergency responders.

title: Printer connectivity
description: The printer is down.
resolution: Reconnected loose Ethernet cable at the wall jack.

title: Unauthorized software request
description: I'm seeing an app called 'Advanced System Optimizer' installed on my machine that I definitely did not authorize. It keeps telling me my registry is broken. Can you remove this?
resolution: Uninstalled the Potentially Unwanted Program (PUP) via SCCM and performed a registry audit to ensure no persistent backdoors were created.

title: I can't reach the fileshare
description: Hey, the server \\FS-PROD-01 is totally unreachable. I'm getting a timeout error when I try to map the drive. I've restarted my laptop but it didn't help.
resolution: Reset the SMB service on the file server and cleared stale TCP connections from the firewall state table.

title: Authentication service unreachable
description: Users cannot login. The authentication service is failing to connect to the User DB. Is the database down or is the network link to the DB cluster severed?
resolution: Restored DNS resolution for the database cluster load balancer.

title: Adobe Creative Cloud License missing
description: Following the recent update to the Adobe Creative Cloud application on my macOS workstation, the software incorrectly indicates that my trial period has expired. This is in direct conflict with my active, company-provisioned enterprise subscription. Please investigate this authentication error and restore access to my licensed applications as a matter of urgency.
resolution: Re-assigned Adobe CC license in the Admin Console and forced a sign-out/sign-in refresh on the local client.

title: Unable to connect to MongoDB
description: The app server keeps failing to handshake with the MongoDB cluster. The logs say 'Connection refused'. We checked the firewall and the port 27017 is definitely open on the app server side.
resolution: Discovered that the MongoDB bindIp setting in mongod.conf was restricted to localhost only, updated it to accept connections from the app server IP range.

title: Core Switch-01 Port Flapping
description: Port Gi1/0/24 on Core Switch-01 is showing intermittent link state changes. Logs indicate high CRC error rates and input drops every 15 minutes. This is causing micro-outages for the entire accounting subnet.
resolution: Replaced the damaged Cat6a patch cable and cleared interface statistics; link stability verified.

title: MFA token loop
description: I'm stuck in an infinite loop with the Authenticator app. Every time I approve the push notification on my phone, it kicks me back to the login screen on my desktop, displaying error AADSTS50011. I've restarted both devices, but nothing works.
resolution: Cleared browser cache and session cookies. Synchronized time settings on the user's mobile device to resolve token timestamp mismatch.

title: Help! Table dropped by accident
description: I was working on the staging environment and accidentally ran a DROP TABLE command instead of TRUNCATE. I need the 'customer_audit_logs' table restored immediately. This is a disaster.
resolution: Restored the table from the latest Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) snapshot taken at 02:00 AM.

title: ASAP: Update font size on shared drive
description: THIS IS A LIFE OR DEATH SITUATION! IF THE FONT SIZE ON THE 'SHARED_DOCS' FOLDER IS NOT INCREASED BY 2 POINTS IMMEDIATELY, THE ENTIRE INFRASTRUCTURE WILL DISINTEGRATE! PANIC!
resolution: Adjusted Windows Explorer view settings to 'Large Icons' for the user.

title: Dust on the secondary cooling intake
description: I noticed a small amount of dust buildup on the vent. Please treat this as a high-priority incident as it could eventually impact hardware lifespan.
resolution: Cleaned intake vent to prevent potential thermal throttling of critical storage array.

title: External SSD not recognized
description: My Samsung T7 SSD isn't showing up in File Explorer when I plug it into my USB-C port. I've tried multiple cables, but my computer just acts like nothing happened. This drive has all my design assets on it.
resolution: Updated the USB host controller drivers in Device Manager; the drive was then detected and mounted successfully.

title: Locked out of AD account
description: I am beyond frustrated. I’m locked out of my account yet again. I tried my password three times, and now it’s giving me the "Account is locked due to multiple failed attempts" error. This is the third time this week this has happened—can someone please actually fix this?
resolution: Unlocked the AD account and cleared cached credentials on the user's workstation that were causing repeated lockout triggers.

title: Browser certificate warning
description: Hey, is anyone else getting "Your connection is not private" errors (NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID) on every site in Chrome? Looks like my machine is missing the company root CA. Any tips on how to get that re-added?
resolution: Re-pushed the Root CA certificate via Group Policy Object to the local certificate store.

title: Cannot open .dwg files in AutoCAD
description: AutoCAD 2024 is failing to open files directly from the network share. It works if I copy the file to my desktop first. It's really slowing down my workflow.
resolution: Adjusted the trusted locations list in AutoCAD settings to include the network drive path.

title: Critical latency in SQL Management Studio
description: SSMS is taking over 30 seconds just to expand a database node. My memory usage is fine, but the application is effectively unusable. This is impacting my deployment timeline.
resolution: Cleared the SSMS environment settings and disabled the 'Auto-check for updates' feature which was causing network hangs.

title: Phishing email reported
description: I am formally reporting a suspicious email received this morning, which appears to be a phishing attempt masquerading as an IT department communication. The message explicitly requests that I "validate my mailbox" by accessing an external hyperlink. Please be advised that I have refrained from interacting with the link, but I am submitting this incident for your immediate investigation and security review.
resolution: Confirmed email as malicious phishing attempt; added sender domain to the O365 blocklist and purged the email from all user mailboxes.

title: MongoDB authentication failure
description: I'm getting 'Authentication failed' when trying to connect to the staging cluster. I verified my credentials, and they are correct. The logs show 'SCRAM-SHA-256' authentication failures.
resolution: Reset the user's password in the MongoDB shell and verified their RBAC permissions were correctly applied to the specific database.

title: NAS drive showing offline status
description: My primary file server (NAS-04) is showing a red light on Bay 3 and is currently inaccessible to the team. The RAID 5 array is reporting a degraded state in the management console. I need someone to check the hardware and replace the drive immediately.
resolution: Replaced faulty Western Digital 8TB SATA drive; RAID rebuild initiated and completed successfully.

title: Single pixel discoloration on desk phone
description: THIS IS A DISASTER! THE DISPLAY ON MY DESK PHONE HAS A TINY DOT THAT IS THE WRONG COLOR! I CANNOT WORK UNDER THESE CONDITIONS! THIS IS AN ABSOLUTE NETWORK CATASTROPHE! HELP ME IMMEDIATELY!!!
resolution: Provided user with a new handset and recycled the old unit.

title: Deadlock errors increasing in frequency
description: Users report records failing to update. Is this a network partition causing retry loops, or inefficient transaction locking in the DB?
resolution: Refactored application transaction logic to minimize lock duration on shared rows.

title: Database connection reset errors
description: Application logs show persistent 'Connection Reset' errors. Database administrators suspect network instability, while network admins suspect disk-bound database hangs.
resolution: Replaced a faulty SFP module on the top-of-rack switch that was causing micro-outages for the database cluster.

title: VPN access keeps dropping
description: My VPN connection to the office keeps cutting out every 15 minutes. I'm using the Cisco AnyConnect client on Windows 11. It's really killing my productivity today, can someone look into this ASAP?
resolution: Identified conflicting MTU settings on the user's home ISP router; adjusted client-side VPN adapter settings to accommodate packet fragmentation.

title: GitHub SSO Loop
description: When I try to sign into GitHub via Okta, I get stuck in a redirect loop. The browser console shows 'ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS' on the SAML assertion URL. I've cleared my Chrome cache and cookies already.
resolution: Cleared the user's session data in the IdP and re-synced the user's email address attribute in the SAML assertion.

title: Error accessing SQL Server
description: My application is throwing a 'Login failed for user' exception when connecting to SQL Server 2019. I verified my permissions in SSMS and I definitely have db_datareader rights. Could you check the server-level mapping?
resolution: Identified that the user's Windows login was not mapped to the specific database schema; mapping added and access granted.

title: Zoom audio driver error
description: My Zoom call keeps failing with error 10006. It says it can't detect a speaker output. I'm using a Jabra headset connected to my MacBook Pro M2.
resolution: Updated the audio drivers in macOS system settings and re-selected the correct output device within the Zoom application settings.

title: Unexpected session termination
description: User is being logged out of the ERP system intermittently. Could be a session timeout policy configuration or a security feature detecting concurrent login sessions from different devices.
resolution: Review session timeout settings and investigate logs for unauthorized concurrent login detection.

title: SSO login failure
description: When I try to access the company dashboard via Okta, I receive a '400 Bad Request' error. I have cleared my browser cache and tried using Incognito mode, but the issue persists on Chrome 124.
resolution: Found a mismatch in the SAML assertion attributes and updated the application integration settings in Okta.

title: Slow file save operations on shared drive
description: Users report that saving large documents to the network drive takes a long time, often resulting in an 'Application Not Responding' error.
resolution: Identified a congested network switch port; moved the file server uplink to a dedicated gigabit port.

title: Printer connectivity issues
description: The MFP in accounting stopped printing again. It says 'Network Error' on the screen. Help.
resolution: Assigned a static IP reservation in the DHCP server to prevent the printer from losing its address after a power cycle.

title: Slack not showing new notifications
description: Slack on my MacBook Pro M2 is being super annoying. I'm not getting any push notifications for direct messages, even though my settings say they are on. I've restarted the app three times already.
resolution: Reset Slack notification preferences and verified that macOS Focus mode was not blocking the app.

title: Font size adjustment in Word
description: PLEASE! I NEED THIS DONE YESTERDAY! THE FONT IN MY WORD DOCUMENT IS SIZE 11 AND I DESPERATELY NEED IT TO BE SIZE 12. THIS IS RUINING MY ENTIRE WEEK, PLEASE RESPOND ASAP!!!
resolution: Assisted user with changing the default font size in Microsoft Word settings.

title: Can't login to Jira
description: I'm getting a 403 Forbidden error when I try to log into the Jira instance using my SSO credentials. It was working fine yesterday. I'm using Chrome on macOS Sonoma.
resolution: Synced user's Okta profile with the Atlassian cloud tenant to resolve attribute synchronization delay.

title: Cannot open files in AutoCAD
description: I keep getting 'Fatal Error: Unhandled Access Violation' when opening DWG files created in AutoCAD 2024. My PC meets all the system requirements. This is extremely frustrating as I have a deadline in two hours.
resolution: Installed the latest AutoCAD 2024.1.2 hotfix, which addresses memory leaks related to large file drawing handles.

title: Browser security warnings on internal portal
description: Every time I access the intranet portal (intranet.corp.local), Chrome throws a 'Your connection is not private' error with NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID. It's making it impossible to check my pay stubs.
resolution: Renewed expired internal SSL certificate on the intranet server and pushed updated CA root to user group policy.

title: Production DB slow queries
description: The site is running super slow today. Our DBAs checked the MariaDB 10.5 instance on Ubuntu 20.04 and found several 'Table scan' warnings in the slow query logs. It seems like a recent deployment missing some indexes.
resolution: Identified two missing non-clustered indexes on the Transactions table and deployed a migration script to add them.

title: Backup server storage full
description: The Veeam backup server is reporting that the local repository is full. We haven't had a successful incremental backup in three days.
resolution: Purged backups older than the 30-day retention policy and resized the VMDK virtual disk to accommodate growth.

title: Access Request for Jira
description: I need access to the engineering Jira board to view the current sprint tasks. My username is jdoe123.
resolution: Granted access to the 'Eng-Dev-Standard' Jira project role.

title: Unable to ping default gateway
description: I cannot reach the default gateway from my workstation. IPCONFIG shows I have a 169.254.x.x address, indicating a DHCP failure. The ethernet cable is plugged into a Cisco Catalyst 2960 switch.
resolution: Identified a misconfigured VLAN on the switch port; reassigned port to the correct Data VLAN and refreshed the DHCP lease.

title: THE SERVER ROOM IS CURRENTLY MELTING
description: THE INTERNAL THERMOMETER IS SHOWING A TEMPERATURE INCREASE OF 0.5 DEGREES CELSIUS. PLEASE RESPOND TO THIS CATASTROPHE AS SOON AS YOU HAVE A CHANCE NEXT WEEK.
resolution: Verified cooling system setpoints; temperature increase was within normal operating range.

title: Database performance extremely slow after patch
description: Following the deployment of OS patches to the Oracle 19c database server on RHEL 8 during the maintenance window last night, the application has experienced a 400% increase in latency. Preliminary analysis indicates a critical degradation in performance characterized by abnormally high IO wait times. This issue is currently impacting all users within the EMEA region, and we require an immediate investigation and resolution to restore standard service levels.
resolution: Identified a misconfiguration in the transparent huge pages settings post-patch; reverted to optimal kernel parameters.

title: Company-wide VPN authentication failure
description: Hey there, just wanted to mention that I'm seeing a slight hiccup with the VPN access. It seems no one in the company can log in. Whenever you get a chance today, could you peek at the firewall logs? Cheers.
resolution: Renewed expired SSL VPN certificate on the primary firewall.

title: Account locked out - AD Error 0xC000006A
description: I'm locked out of my workstation again. It keeps giving me error 0xC000006A when I try to log in with my domain credentials. This is the third time today and I have a deadline.
resolution: Identified a stale credential stored in Windows Credential Manager for a mapped network drive. Cleared cache and forced a domain password sync.

title: Forgotten MFA device
description: I'm currently traveling for a conference and I left my hardware security key back at the office. I'm locked out of my corporate email and I really need to check my inbox before tomorrow's meeting.
resolution: Verified identity via manager approval and issued a temporary bypass code valid for 4 hours.

title: Data migration error
description: Attempting to migrate user profiles to the new NAS migration target, but the Robocopy job keeps failing with error 5. I'm running the command as Administrator, but it seems like it's getting stuck on locked system files.
resolution: Added the /ZB (restartable mode with backup) flag to the Robocopy script to bypass file locks and handle permission errors gracefully.

title: Unable to reach external website
description: We need access to the vendor portal at www.vendor-secure.com, but our firewall is blocking it. The error page shows 'Access Denied: Category Restricted'.
resolution: Added the vendor domain to the corporate firewall whitelist as an exception for the relevant department.

title: Total network outage in Building 3
description: No one in the entire wing can access local files or the internet. All phones are showing 'No Network'. Please help immediately, this is an emergency.
resolution: Resolved an upstream failure caused by a firmware bug in the building’s distribution switch. Rolled back the firmware and performed a cold boot of the stack.

title: Need more space for archives
description: The current archival storage pool is nearly full. We need an additional 2TB of provisioned space for the upcoming project data migration by Friday. Please advise on the process.
resolution: Created a new storage pool and presented a 2TB LUN to the archival server, then mapped it as a mount point.

title: VPN connection drops in Cisco AnyConnect
description: My VPN keeps dropping every 15 minutes while I'm using the proprietary internal web app. The console log shows 'DTLS tunnel disconnected'. Can you fix this? It's really affecting my workflow.
resolution: Disabled the 'Block connections to untrusted servers' setting in the Cisco AnyConnect profile and updated the client to the latest stable release.

title: Forgotten MFA device
description: I left my YubiKey at home and can't get into my laptop. Can you please reset my MFA so I can work from home today?
resolution: Verified identity via manager and issued a temporary bypass code valid for 4 hours.

title: Laptop disk space warning
description: Hey, my MacBook Pro is yelling at me that the disk is almost full. I can't even open Chrome anymore because it says there isn't enough memory to swap files. Can you help me figure out what's hogging all the space?
resolution: Cleared 45GB of temporary cache files and purged the local Time Machine snapshots.

title: Cannot access VPN (GlobalProtect) - Error 401
description: I'm trying to connect to the corporate VPN from my home network on Windows 11. Every time I hit connect, it prompts for credentials and then immediately throws 'Error 401: Authentication Failed' despite using the correct MFA-verified password. I’ve already tried clearing the cache in the GlobalProtect settings.
resolution: Reset the user's AD account lock status and synchronized the MFA token on the Duo server.

title: Need access to Q4 Sales Folder
description: Hi team, could you please grant me read/write access to the 'Q4_Sales_Project' folder on the fileserver? My current permissions only allow read access, which is preventing me from updating the tracking spreadsheet. My user ID is jsmith77.
resolution: Updated group policy permissions for the 'Sales_Team_RW' security group to include the user.

title: Cloud storage sync loop
description: OneDrive on my laptop is stuck in a 'Processing changes' loop and never finishes syncing my files. I've tried signing out and back in but it hasn't helped. It's been like this for three days.
resolution: Cleared the OneDrive cache folder and repaired the local sync database via the command line tool.

title: Reported lost company laptop
description: I left my company-issued MacBook Pro (Serial: C02XXXXXXX) in a taxi last night. It has full disk encryption enabled, but I am reporting it lost so we can initiate a remote wipe if necessary.
resolution: Initiated remote wipe command via Jamf Pro and marked the device as lost in the asset management system.

title: BitLocker recovery screen on boot
description: My laptop (Dell Latitude 5420) is stuck on the blue BitLocker recovery screen after a BIOS update this morning. I've tried rebooting three times, but it keeps asking for a 48-digit recovery key. I have a client presentation in an hour and I'm panicking.
resolution: Retrieved BitLocker recovery key from Azure AD device portal. Assisted user in manual entry of key and verified disk integrity post-reboot.

title: Requesting sudo access
description: Hey, any chance you can hook me up with sudo access on server-app-04? I need to install some dependencies for the new patch release and I'm currently hitting a permissions wall.
resolution: Denied. Directed user to submit a formal change request via the security policy portal.

title: High latency on iSCSI target
description: The SAN performance has been terrible all morning. We are seeing average latency of 250ms on our database LUNs. Seems like we might have a broadcast storm or a misconfiguration on the dedicated iSCSI VLAN.
resolution: Identified a misconfigured jumbo frames setting on one of the host NICs; corrected MTU to 9000 to match the storage fabric.

title: Cannot access shared drive
description: Hey, I’ve lost access to the \\FILESERVER\Finance folder and am getting an 'Access Denied' error. I haven't changed anything on my end, could you take a look at my permissions?
resolution: User was accidentally removed from the 'Finance-Read-Only' security group. Re-added user to the group and verified permission propagation.

title: Lost password for local admin
description: Hey, I forgot the local admin password for my Dell Latitude laptop. I need to install some drivers for my project, but I'm locked out of the elevated prompt.
resolution: Used the LAPS (Local Administrator Password Solution) portal to retrieve the current recovery password for the machine.

title: Replenish storage pool
description: The Storage Spaces pool on our primary file server is reporting 92% utilization. We need to add more physical disks to the server rack to prevent a potential service outage. Please advise on procurement.
resolution: Added two 4TB SAS drives to the storage pool and initiated the storage tier rebalancing.

title: Need a dump of the staging DB
description: Can someone provide a full SQL dump of the staging database, specifically the 'Customers' and 'Transactions' schemas? I need it for local testing on my MacBook Pro running macOS Monterey.
resolution: Provided a secure link to the latest sanitized backup file from the nightly automated export.

title: Need access to Reporting DB
description: Hi, could you please grant me read-only access to the Reporting_Prod database? I need to run some audits for the Q3 financial review. Thanks!
resolution: Granted db_datareader role to the user's Active Directory account.

title: Access to Jira board denied
description: I am writing to formally report an access issue regarding the 'Q3 Infrastructure Project' board in Jira. Despite my team members maintaining full visibility of the board, I am consistently receiving an 'Insufficient Permissions' error message when attempting to access it. I request a thorough review of my user profile and account permissions to rectify this discrepancy and restore my access to the project board.
resolution: Added user to the 'Jira_Infrastructure_Project' permission scheme.

title: DHCP Scope Exhaustion
description: Heads up, we've got reports that new devices can't grab IPs in the Main Office VLAN. Looks like the 10.10.20.0/24 scope on the DHCP server is completely tapped out.
resolution: Extended the DHCP scope mask from /24 to /23 and adjusted the lease time from 8 days to 24 hours to reclaim stale IPs.

title: Table corruption reported in logs
description: Help! The system logs are showing 'Database block corruption' on index pages for the 'Users' table. We are running MySQL 8.0 on Ubuntu 20.04. How do we recover without losing the last two hours of data?
resolution: Ran 'innodb_force_recovery' to dump the data, recreated the table, and imported the dump to clear the corruption.

title: Network slow, help?
description: Internet is super slow today. Can't load files from the server. Is something broken?
resolution: Investigated bandwidth utilization and discovered a large unauthorized backup process running on a workstation; throttled the process and optimized local QoS settings.

title: Cannot reach external website
description: I’m trying to access our cloud accounting software and keep getting a connection timeout error, which is completely blocking my workflow. My internet is clearly working fine since I can load Google without any issues, so this is obviously an issue with this specific site. I need this fixed immediately because I can't get any of my work done.
resolution: White-listed the cloud provider's new IP range on the edge firewall.

title: Wireless card driver issue
description: My laptop is absolutely useless because the Wi-Fi keeps dropping every five minutes. I've already restarted the machine twice and nothing changes. I checked the device manager and it's throwing a Code 10 error for the "Intel Wi-Fi 6 AX200," which clearly shows the driver is failing. Can someone actually fix this so I can get back to work?
resolution: Performed a clean uninstall of the wireless driver and installed the latest manufacturer version.

title: Firewall Rule Request
description: Hi team, we need port 8443 opened between the app server and the database segment for the new project. Can you handle this?
resolution: Added the requested ACL to the edge firewall and verified connectivity via telnet.

title: Replication lag on read-replica
description: Our read-only replica (replica-01) is lagging by over 45 minutes behind the primary. This is causing inconsistent data display for users in the EMEA region. Please investigate why the binlog apply is stalling.
resolution: Identified a long-running transaction on the primary that blocked replication; optimized the transaction to finish quickly, allowing the replica to catch up.

title: Cloud storage sync failure
description: My OneDrive client on Windows 11 keeps throwing error 0x8004de40. It won't sync any files from my Desktop folder to the cloud. I've restarted the app three times with no luck.
resolution: Reset the OneDrive sync engine using the command line tool; re-authenticated the account and sync status is now current.

title: SAN connectivity loss on ESXi host
description: Host esx-04 lost connection to the LUNs on the PureStorage FlashArray. VMs on this host have crashed. Port status on the FC switch shows 'No Light'.
resolution: Reseated the SFP module on the Fibre Channel switch; link restored and LUNs re-scanned in vCenter.

title: My MFA isn't sending codes
description: I've been trying to log into the portal for twenty minutes but the Duo push notifications aren't hitting my phone. I'm late for a client meeting, please fix this!
resolution: Synced the user's hardware token as a temporary workaround and re-registered their mobile device in the Duo admin console.

title: SSD failure predicted on server
description: The iDRAC console on server HOST-DL380-08 is reporting a 'Predictive Failure' on physical drive slot 4. It's a 1.92TB SAS SSD. We should replace this before it dies completely.
resolution: Scheduled a hot-swap replacement of the failed drive and verified the RAID controller initiated a successful rebuild.

title: Slow read/write speeds on shared drive
description: Is anyone else experiencing slow speeds on the Z: drive? Saving a 50MB Excel file takes forever. It seems to happen every afternoon around 2 PM.
resolution: Identified a misconfigured scheduled task running a full virus scan on the file server during business hours; adjusted task timing.

title: Adobe Acrobat Pro crashing on startup
description: I am writing to formally report a persistent functional failure regarding Adobe Acrobat. Upon attempting to open any PDF document, the application terminates immediately, consistently displaying error code 0xc0000005. I am currently operating on the latest version of macOS Sonoma. This recurring technical issue has become a significant impediment to my professional responsibilities, specifically hindering my ability to perform required contract reviews. Please prioritize the resolution of this matter.
resolution: Performed a clean re-installation of Adobe Acrobat using the Adobe Cleaner Tool to remove residual registry entries.

title: Duplicate records in production
description: We are noticing thousands of duplicate entries in our 'audit_logs' table. It seems like the batch job is running twice. Can we clean this up?
resolution: Used a Common Table Expression (CTE) to identify and delete duplicate rows while retaining the earliest record.

title: Compromised machine suspected
description: My machine has been running extremely slow today and the CPU usage for 'svchost.exe' is constantly at 99%. I noticed a window pop up briefly mentioning a remote connection attempt. I've disconnected it from the network.
resolution: Isolated machine from VLAN. Ran full scan with CrowdStrike Falcon; identified and quarantined a malicious trojan payload. Re-imaged device to ensure complete remediation.

title: Account lockout after failed MFA
description: This is the third time today my account has been locked and I am beyond fed up. I keep getting "Access Denied: Error 0x80048823" every single time I try to approve the push notification on my iPhone 14. Fix my lockout status immediately; I have actual work to do.
resolution: Reset AD account lockout and synchronized Azure MFA service principal.

title: Request for Jira project access
description: Hi team, could you please grant me developer-level access to the 'Project-X' board in Jira? My current login only allows read-only access and I need to update my task statuses.
resolution: Added user to the 'Dev-Team-Alpha' role within the Jira project permission scheme.

title: Authentication failure on WPA2 Enterprise
description: Every time I try to join the corporate wireless, it prompts for credentials, but then immediately fails. I am using my standard AD login.
resolution: Synchronized the time on the client machine with the domain controller to fix an expired Kerberos ticket issue.

title: Latency spikes in VLAN 20
description: Users in the Finance department are reporting intermittent lag when accessing cloud-based ERP systems. Traceroutes show latency spikes originating at the Distribution Layer switch (DIST-SW-02). CPU utilization on the switch backplane is fluctuating between 85-95%.
resolution: Identified a broadcast storm caused by a loop on an unmanaged switch in the Finance office; removed the rogue device and implemented port security.

title: Zoom app audio input failure
description: My Zoom app doesn't recognize my Jabra headset even though Windows settings sees it perfectly. I've tried changing the input settings in the Zoom audio menu, but it shows 'No input device found'. Very annoying during client meetings.
resolution: Updated the audio drivers in Device Manager and granted Zoom explicit microphone permissions within Windows Privacy Settings.

title: DNS resolution failing
description: Users are reporting that they can't access internal websites like our intranet. It seems like DNS queries are timing out. Running nslookup returns 'DNS request timed out' consistently.
resolution: Restarted the DNS Server service on DC01 and cleared the cache; verified root hints were configured correctly.

title: Static IP conflict
description: Our network management system is consistently triggering alerts indicating an IP address conflict involving 192.168.1.50. It appears that two distinct devices are contending for this singular address, resulting in network instability. I request that your team investigate these alerts immediately to identify the conflicting hardware and resolve the addressing issue.
resolution: Identified a rogue wireless router plugged into a wall jack by a user; disabled the port and confiscated the device.

title: High latency on guest Wi-Fi
description: The guest network in the lobby is extremely slow today. Guests are complaining that they can't even load basic web pages. Please investigate the APs in that area.
resolution: Identified a rogue wireless access point causing channel interference and adjusted the channel width on the primary APs to reduce congestion.

title: Lost password
description: I am currently unable to access the network due to a forgotten password. Please facilitate a formal reset of my credentials to restore my access immediately.
resolution: Verified identity via manager and performed a forced password reset on the domain controller.

title: Collation mismatch
description: When trying to join two tables, I get an error about a collation conflict: 'SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS' vs 'Latin1_General_CI_AS'. How can I resolve this for my report?
resolution: Provided the user with a query snippet using the COLLATE clause to temporarily force a common collation for the join operation.

title: Login failed
description: I can't log in to the database. It says my account is locked. This is very frustrating as I have a deadline in an hour.
resolution: Unlocked the user account and verified the password expiration policy settings.

title: Excel freezing with large datasets
description: Every time I try to run a VLOOKUP on a spreadsheet with over 50,000 rows, Excel becomes unresponsive and eventually force closes. I need this data for a meeting in an hour. Please fix this ASAP.
resolution: Converted the data range into an Excel Table and disabled 'Automatic Calculation' during the process.

title: Zoom audio loop issues
description: I am experiencing an audio feedback loop whenever I join a meeting on Zoom version 5.17. I am using a Jabra Evolve2 headset on a Dell Latitude 7440. It makes it impossible to conduct client calls.
resolution: Updated the Jabra firmware and adjusted the audio input/output settings in Zoom to specifically select the headset rather than the system default.

title: DHCP server scope exhausted
description: Users are reporting that they can't get an IP address when they join the network today. It seems like the DHCP server is out of addresses in the current subnet range.
resolution: Expanded the DHCP address scope on the server from /24 to /23 to accommodate the increased number of BYOD devices connected to the network.

title: Missing Excel Add-in
description: Hey, looks like the custom financial add-in went missing after the Office update this morning. Could you take a look and see if it got disabled? Really need it to wrap up the quarterly budget!
resolution: Re-enabled the COM Add-in via the Excel Options menu and updated the registry keys for Trusted Locations.

title: Cannot export reports in SAP
description: Exporting to Excel from SAP GUI 7.70 keeps failing with a 'File Access Denied' error. I have full permissions on the target directory. Please assist ASAP.
resolution: Modified the SAP GUI security settings to allow the 'SAP GUI Scripting' interface to interact with the local file system.

title: Email account sending suspicious bounce-backs
description: User says they are getting delivery failure notifications for emails they never sent. Could be a misconfigured automated script or an account takeover.
resolution: Reset credentials, check for unauthorized forwarding rules, and update SPF/DKIM records.

title: Provisioning request for new hire
description: Please provision a new domain account for John Doe starting next Monday. He will need access to Email, Jira, and the internal Wiki. Please ensure he is added to the 'Engineering_All' distribution list.
resolution: Created user object in AD, assigned O365 E3 license, and configured group memberships.

title: User cannot access internal file share
description: User reports 'Access Denied' when trying to reach a departmental folder. It is unclear if their permissions were revoked during the recent security audit or if the folder permissions were incorrectly migrated.
resolution: Audit Group Policy Object (GPO) memberships and verify folder NTFS permissions.

title: Switch port flapping in Server Room B
description: Port 22 on switch CISCO-9300-01 is flapping constantly. It is causing the ESXi host connected to it to migrate VMs repeatedly. Please look into this ASAP.
resolution: Replaced damaged Cat6a patch cable between server rack and switch.

title: Browser extension interfering with payroll app
description: I cannot hit the 'Submit' button on the payroll site. It seems like one of my Chrome extensions is blocking the script. Can you help me figure out which one?
resolution: Used Incognito mode to confirm extension interference, then identified the ad-blocker as the culprit and whitelisted the payroll domain.

title: Slow import
description: I am trying to upload a CSV with 500k rows but it just hangs indefinitely. Database is hosted on AWS RDS. Is there a size limit I don't know about?
resolution: Advised user to use the 'LOAD DATA INFILE' command rather than the GUI import wizard for large datasets.

title: Slow file transfers to NAS
description: Transferring large video files to the shared NAS is taking hours. It used to be much faster. I'm connected via 1Gbps ethernet, but I'm only seeing 10MB/s speeds.
resolution: Identified a negotiated speed mismatch on the switch port; forced the port to 1000Mbps Full Duplex.

title: Printer on 2nd floor is unreachable
description: This formal notification serves to report a persistent connectivity failure regarding the LaserJet Pro M402n located on the 2nd floor. The device is currently inaccessible via the network, resulting in consistent "Host Unreachable" error messages for all users attempting to submit print jobs. Physical inspection confirms that the Ethernet cable is securely connected; however, the printer's status indicator is displaying a solid amber light, indicating a critical hardware or configuration fault that requires immediate technical intervention.
resolution: Reset the static IP configuration on the printer interface and assigned it a new reserved address via DHCP.

title: Bad request error on portal
description: Ugh, every time I try to log into the internal portal, I get a '400 Bad Request' error page. I've cleared my Chrome cache and tried Edge, but it's the same. My project is stalled because of this.
resolution: Identified header overflow issue; cleared user's browser cookies and updated server-side buffer settings.

title: VPN connection failing with 'Authentication Error'
description: User cannot connect to VPN. System displays generic error. Root cause could be an expired certificate or a blocked account status due to suspected compromise.
resolution: Renew security certificate and verify account status against active threats.

title: Requesting sudo access
description: I need sudo privileges on the development Linux servers (Ubuntu 22.04 LTS) for my current project. My manager approved this via email.
resolution: Denied: Internal policy requires senior approval for sudo access; escalated to Manager.

title: Snapshot deletion failure
description: I tried to delete an old snapshot for our development VM, but I'm getting 'An error occurred while consolidating disks'. The state is stuck in progress. Please advise.
resolution: Manually consolidated the delta files using the ESXi command line interface after stopping the associated virtual machine.

title: Ethernet port dead on workstation 402
description: Hey, my HP EliteDesk isn't getting any link lights on the NIC. I've already tried swapping in a known-good Cat6 cable and testing a different wall jack, but still nothing. Any ideas?
resolution: Traced the wall jack to a faulty port on the Cisco Catalyst switch; moved the patch cable to a different, active switch port.

title: URGENT: Production DB down
