description: The database system is currently experiencing a total service outage. Users are reporting persistent authentication failures and a complete inability to load the dashboard interface. Given that the system was fully operational ten minutes ago, please investigate this critical degradation immediately and restore service as a matter of priority.
resolution: Identified a memory leak in a stored procedure that caused the SQL process to hit the max server memory limit; restarted the SQL Server service and purged the procedure cache.

title: Potential Phishing Email Received
description: I received an email claiming to be from the IT department asking me to verify my credentials at a link that looks like 'corp-portal-verify.com'. It seems fishy, so I didn't click it, but I wanted to make sure we're safe. Should I delete it or forward it to someone?
resolution: Confirmed email as phishing attempt. Added sender domain to the O365 tenant blocklist and purged the email from all user inboxes across the organization.

title: Esxi host disconnected from vCenter
description: Hey team, heads up that esxi-prod-04 has dropped out of vCenter and is showing as "not responding." The host has power, but I can't reach the management IP over SSH.
resolution: Physically reseated the management NIC; restarted the management agents (services.sh) on the host.

title: Can't access printer
description: The printer in the hallway is offline again. It says 'Network Error' on the screen. Please fix it fast.
resolution: Static IP address conflict found; assigned a new reserved IP to the printer via DHCP.

title: MFA prompt not appearing
description: I am trying to log into the ERP system, but the Duo push notification never hits my phone. I have stable internet, and my app is updated to the latest version. This is blocking my work for the day.
resolution: Resynchronized the user's Duo token in the admin dashboard and cleared the local cache on the mobile device.

title: Unable to connect to shared printer
description: The accounting printer (HP LaserJet M507) is offline for everyone. I've tried rebooting it, but it's not pulling an IP address from the server. Windows 10 machines.
resolution: Discovered the printer was set to a manual IP conflict; reset network settings and configured for DHCP reservation.

title: Storage Array LUN latency
description: Our Nimble storage array is reporting 50ms latency on Volume_DB_01. This is causing SQL timeouts for our primary ERP application. Please investigate immediately.
resolution: Identified a snapshot retention issue causing excessive metadata overhead; purged expired snapshots and rebalanced IOPS.

title: Teams camera frozen
description: My camera freezes every time I join a meeting on Teams. It works fine in the Windows Camera app, so I know the webcam isn't broken. Frustrating as I have a presentation in 20 minutes.
resolution: Disabled 'GPU Hardware Acceleration' within the Teams settings to resolve compatibility issues with the integrated graphics driver.

title: A slight delay in network packet delivery
description: I've noticed a minor latency issue in our backbone fiber link. It is barely noticeable, but I wanted to flag it as an urgent priority for the engineering team.
resolution: Identified and replaced a failing SFP+ transceiver that was causing intermittent packet loss.

title: Unable to access production database
description: I am getting a 'Permission Denied (publickey)' error when attempting to SSH into the production Linux server (IP: 10.0.4.15). My public key was rotated this morning. Please verify if the new key was added to authorized_keys.
resolution: Found that the public key was uploaded to the staging environment by mistake; corrected the deployment script to target production.

title: Can't access Jira board
description: I'm trying to view the sprint board for the 'Project X' team but Jira says I don't have the necessary permissions. It's really slowing down my workflow this morning. Can you fix this ASAP?
resolution: User was not added to the project-specific permission scheme. Granted 'Developer' role access.

title: SSH timeout to dev server
description: I keep getting a 'Connection timed out' when trying to SSH into the staging server (10.0.50.22) from my local terminal on macOS Monterey. It worked fine yesterday. Any firewall changes?
resolution: Added the user's current dynamic IP range to the whitelist on the perimeter firewall.

title: Python script failing to import pandas
description: I'm getting an 'ImportError: DLL load failed' when trying to run my data analysis script in VS Code. My environment is Python 3.10. I tried pip installing it again but it didn't help.
resolution: Identified a conflict between the system path and the virtual environment; updated the path variable to point correctly to the local site-packages.

title: Need access to Shared Drive S:
description: Hi, I just moved to the Marketing team and I can't see the S: drive on my Windows 11 laptop. My manager said I should have access to the 'Campaigns' folder. Can you please add me to the correct AD security group?
resolution: Added user to the 'SEC_Marketing_Shared_Drive' security group and instructed user to sign out and back in to refresh group policy.

title: Help! Table dropped by accident
description: Hey, total disaster here—I accidentally ran a DROP TABLE instead of TRUNCATE on the customer_audit_logs table in staging. Could you please help me restore it ASAP?
resolution: Restored the table from the latest Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) snapshot taken at 02:00 AM.

title: Salesforce desktop app crashes on startup
description: Hey, having some trouble with the Salesforce desktop app on my MacBook Pro (macOS Sonoma 14.2). It keeps crashing right when I try to open it. I’ve already tried a reinstall and clearing the cache, but no luck—the logs are showing a SIGABRT error. Could someone take a look? Thanks!
resolution: Updated the Salesforce CLI and cleared the ~/Library/Application Support/Salesforce directory to resolve the corrupted configuration files.

title: Jira dashboard widgets blank
description: The widgets on my Jira dashboard aren't loading, just showing grey boxes. I am using the latest version of Firefox. Everyone else on the team seems fine.
resolution: Identified a browser extension (AdBlocker) that was interfering with the dashboard script loading; added Jira domain to the whitelist.

title: Cannot print to office printer
description: EMERGENCY! EVERYTHING IS BROKEN! THE ENTIRE OFFICE IS AT A STANDSTILL BECAUSE THE PRINTER ISN'T SHOWING UP! DROP EVERYTHING AND FIX THIS RIGHT NOW OR WE ARE ALL GOING TO LOSE OUR JOBS!!!
resolution: Reconnected printer to the local network via DHCP reservation.

title: Critical vulnerability patch needed
description: The security team flagged my machine for running an outdated version of Java. I cannot update it manually as I don't have local admin rights. Please update it.
resolution: Pushed the Java 8 update 401 via SCCM to the user's workstation.

title: New hire onboarding: Missing JIRA permissions
description: Hi team, I am a new developer starting today. I have access to the main dashboard but I cannot open any tickets in the Engineering project. It says 'Insufficient permissions' whenever I try to move a task to 'In Progress'.
resolution: Added user to the 'Dev-Project-Contributors' AD group and refreshed JIRA project permissions.

title: USB drive blocked by Endpoint Protection
description: Hey, I'm trying to plug in my Kingston DataTraveler to transfer some project files to my workstation (WS-9922), but Carbon Black keeps killing the process. I get error code 0x80070005: Access Denied. Can you whitelist this drive for me?
resolution: USB mass storage device restricted by Group Policy for security compliance. Denied request to whitelist; provided instructions for using encrypted OneDrive share instead.

title: SSD wear level alert
description: Just got an email from the server monitor saying the SSDs in our cache tier are at 92% wear level. Should I be worried? Everything seems fine for now, but I want to know when we need to replace them.
resolution: Analyzed the S.M.A.R.T. data and confirmed the drives are still within operational spec; scheduled a proactive replacement for the next quarterly maintenance cycle.

title: SSL Certificate expiration
description: The browser is showing 'Your connection is not private' when accessing our internal Wiki. It seems like the SSL certificate for wiki.internal.corp has expired as of this morning.
resolution: Renewed the internal CA certificate and pushed it to the web server IIS bindings.

title: VPN Gateway latency spikes
description: Users are reporting severe lag when connecting via the Cisco ASA 5500-X gateway. Performance monitors indicate CPU usage is hitting 98% during peak hours. Packet loss is reaching 15%.
resolution: Identified a memory leak in firmware version 9.8.1; updated to 9.8.4 to resolve the process crash.

title: Unauthorized device detected on secure port
description: The IDS flagged an unauthorized MAC address connected to port 48 in the server room. The device is currently showing as 'unknown' and is attempting to probe internal subnets.
resolution: Identified device as an unmanaged switch brought in by a contractor; port was shut down and contractor notified.

title: Intermittent timeouts when accessing the CRM portal
description: Users are reporting that the CRM application frequently hangs or times out after 10-15 seconds of inactivity. It is unclear if the web server is struggling or if there is packet loss.
resolution: Increased keep-alive timeout on the load balancer to prevent premature session termination.

title: System slow and unresponsive after login
description: User reports high latency immediately upon logging in. Could be an overloaded SSO authentication server or a deep-packet inspection process scanning traffic upon entry.
resolution: Analyze login logs to identify bottlenecks in the identity provider or security scanning suite.

title: Cannot access shared drive
description: I can't see the \\FILE-SRV01\Marketing folder anymore. It keeps saying 'Network path not found' when I try to map it. Windows 10 is updated. It worked fine yesterday.
resolution: Mapped drive was disconnected due to a stale SMB session; flushed DNS cache and re-authenticated the user.

title: VPN Authentication Failure - Error 691
description: I am unable to connect to the corporate VPN using my MacBook Pro running macOS Sonoma. Every time I initiate the connection, I receive 'Error 691: The remote connection was denied because the username and password combination you provided is not recognized'. I have confirmed my AD credentials are correct as they work on the Outlook web portal.
resolution: Reset the user's AD password sync in the Identity Provider portal and cleared the cached VPN credentials in the Keychain Access utility.

title: Can't connect to VPN
description: I am losing my mind here. My Cisco AnyConnect VPN was working perfectly fine yesterday morning, and now all of a sudden, it refuses to connect on macOS Monterey, constantly throwing an "invalid server certificate" error. I have work to do and this is completely blocking me—fix this immediately.
resolution: Updated the root CA certificate on the user's machine as the previous one had expired.

title: Database connection timeout in production
description: App is throwing connection timeouts since the patch yesterday. Error code 0x80004005. Please check.
resolution: Identified a misconfiguration in the connection string following the patch deployment; updated the application settings to point to the correct failover cluster node.

title: Visual Studio Code terminal won't launch
description: Integrated terminal in VS Code just shows a blank screen and crashes after a few seconds. Running on Windows 10. I suspect it's related to the recent PowerShell update. Can you take a look?
resolution: Updated the integrated terminal profile settings in VS Code to point to the correct path for PowerShell 7.

title: Firewall Rule propagation failure
description: I tried to push a new security policy to our edge firewalls, but the management console is reporting a 'Sync Failed' status. It seems like the HA pair is out of sync. Current version is PAN-OS 10.1.
resolution: Cleared the candidate configuration manually and force-synced the device state from the primary firewall.

title: Intermittent packet loss on VLAN 20
description: We are experiencing significant packet loss across the engineering department on VLAN 20. Pings to the default gateway show a 15% drop rate, and we are seeing CRC errors on the uplink port of the access switch.
resolution: Replaced a faulty SFP module and fiber patch cable on the distribution switch uplink.

title: SQL Server connection timeout on App-Prod-01
description: We are experiencing intermittent connection timeouts when the web frontend tries to query the primary SQL instance. Error code 0x80131904 appears in the logs during high traffic spikes. Server OS is Windows Server 2022. Please investigate if there is a connection pool exhaustion issue.
resolution: Increased max connection pool size in web.config and optimized long-running execution plans.

title: Insufficient space on production database volume
description: Alert from Nagios: /dev/sdb1 is at 98% capacity. This is our SQL production volume and we are seeing timeout errors in the application logs. Please expand the LVM partition immediately.
resolution: Expanded the underlying VMware VMDK and grew the LVM physical volume, volume group, and logical volume online without downtime.

title: EMERGENCY: THE OFFICE IS ON FIRE
description: Wait, no, it's just a coffee spill on the carpet. Can someone please put a ticket in to have the cleaning crew vacuum this spot? It's really bothering me.
resolution: Notified facilities team to clean the spill.

title: Cannot access shared drive
description: I am once again unable to access the \\FileServer01\Marketing drive and keep getting hit with the "Network path not found" error (0x80070035). I’m running Windows 10 Pro and this is completely blocking my workflow. Please fix this.
resolution: Flushed DNS cache and re-mapped the network drive using the server's static IP address instead of the hostname.

title: Cannot access VCenter
description: I keep getting a 503 Service Unavailable error when trying to access the vSphere client. I’ve checked the ESXi hosts and they seem to be running fine, but I can't manage my VMs. Help.
resolution: Restarted the vCenter Server Appliance (VCSA) services via SSH; identity management service was hung.

title: Small observation about account security
description: It seems that the administrator password for the core production database has been posted on the public company Slack channel for the last 48 hours. Just wanted to let you know.
resolution: Revoked existing credentials, rotated all database keys, and sanitized Slack message history.

title: Password reset link not working
description: User reports the reset link leads to a 403 Forbidden page. Could be an expired link or a triggered security block on the user's IP due to repeated invalid requests.
resolution: Clear browser cache and verify if the user's IP is on the security blocklist.

title: Jira keeps giving me 503 errors
description: Hey, Jira is down again. I keep getting a 503 Service Unavailable error when I try to update my sprint tickets. It's really slowing down our daily standup.
resolution: Performed a rolling restart of the Jira application nodes; service restored.

title: Corruption in archive database
description: I'm trying to open the 2022 Archive database and it's throwing a 'Page Checksum Failure' error. It seems like the file is corrupted. Help, this is urgent!
resolution: Restored the database from the last known good backup to a temporary instance and exported the requested data.

title: Casual inquiry regarding VPN access
description: Hi there, I noticed that our global VPN gateway has been completely bypassed by an unauthorized external script. No rush at all, but could you take a look at your convenience?
resolution: Initiated emergency network lockdown and blocked the malicious IP range.

title: Unable to ping default gateway
description: I am writing to formally report a persistent network connectivity failure affecting my workstation. Upon technical inspection, it has been confirmed that I am unable to reach the default gateway. Diagnostic output from the ipconfig command reveals that the workstation has been assigned an APIPA address in the 169.254.x.x range, which indicates a critical failure in the DHCP assignment process. Despite the physical ethernet connection to the Cisco Catalyst 2960 switch being verified, the device remains unable to obtain a valid network configuration. Please address this infrastructure issue as a priority.
resolution: Identified a misconfigured VLAN on the switch port; reassigned port to the correct Data VLAN and refreshed the DHCP lease.

title: Guest Wi-Fi showing 'Connected, no internet'
description: Visitors are complaining that they can connect to the Guest network but never get the splash page. They are stuck on 'Connected, no internet'. Please look into this as soon as possible, it makes us look unprofessional.
resolution: The Captive Portal service had stalled on the firewall appliance; restarted the service and cleared the active session table.

title: Printer queue stalled
description: The big copier on floor 2 keeps printing the same document over and over. I tried clearing the print queue on the print server but it keeps popping back up. This is very annoying.
resolution: Cleared the spooler directory on the print server and updated the driver to the latest V4 PCL6 version.

title: iSCSI session flapping
description: We are seeing intermittent connectivity losses to the iSCSI target. The switch logs show 'Link Flap' events on ports connected to the storage controller. This is causing Windows Event ID 129 errors on the host.
resolution: Replaced faulty SFP+ module on the core switch and verified network stability for the iSCSI traffic.

title: Complete regional data center outage
description: Hi team, I hope you are having a pleasant afternoon. It appears that all server connectivity for the entire East Coast region has dropped. Please let me know if you might have a spare moment to investigate this at your earliest convenience. Thank you!
resolution: Replaced faulty fiber uplink module in the core router.

title: SAML SSO error on Chrome
description: Getting an 'Error 403: app_not_configured_for_user' when trying to launch Salesforce via Okta. I'm using Chrome v118 on Windows 11. Everyone else on my team can get in fine.
resolution: Assigned the user to the Salesforce application integration in Okta Admin Console.

title: MFA prompt not appearing
description: I'm trying to log into O365 on my new MacBook Pro M3, but the Microsoft Authenticator prompt never pushes to my phone. I've reinstalled the app and checked my cellular connection.
resolution: Removed the user's secondary device from the Entra ID portal and re-registered the MFA token.

title: VPN access keeps dropping
description: Hey, my VPN keeps kicking me off every time I try to map a network drive. I'm running Windows 11 and using the latest Cisco AnyConnect client. It just says 'Connection lost - reconnecting' and then eventually fails entirely.
resolution: Increased the idle timeout threshold on the headend ASA firewall and updated the user's client profile.

title: Salesforce page unresponsive
description: Salesforce is freezing whenever I try to generate a quarterly report. The browser console shows a 'Script timeout' error at line 442. This is happening on Chrome 122.0 on macOS Sonoma.
resolution: Identified a malformed custom report filter; updated the filter logic and cleared browser cache.

title: AutoCAD license error
description: Autocad is giving me a license error code 1.1.0 every time I launch it. It says it cannot connect to the license server on the network. I've checked my connection and I am definitely connected to the office LAN.
resolution: Refreshed the license lease via the Autodesk Desktop Licensing Service and cleared the local login cache.

title: Outlook search returning zero results
description: My search bar in Outlook 365 isn't finding any emails sent after Monday. I've tried rebuilding the index in Windows Search Options, but it's still stuck at 'Indexing pending'. My machine is a Dell Latitude 5440.
resolution: Manually reset the Indexing Service via Command Prompt and performed an online repair of the Microsoft 365 Office suite.

title: File access denied
description: I'm trying to open our team's shared folder, but I keep getting a permission error. The OS says 'Access Denied'. This is really holding me up on the quarterly report.
resolution: Updated the user's AD security group membership to include 'Finance_RW'; user logged out and back in to refresh the Kerberos token.

title: Core Switch Uplink Failure
description: The primary uplink on CORE-SW-01 (Cisco Catalyst 9300) has dropped to a state of err-disabled. We are seeing constant flapping on interface Te1/1/1 and the logs indicate high CRC errors. This has isolated the entire second-floor subnet from the server farm.
resolution: Reset the physical transceiver module and re-seated the fiber patch cable, clearing the interface error counters.

title: New printer not getting IP from DHCP
description: We are trying to commission a new HP LaserJet Pro in the marketing wing. The device is connected to Port 14 on switch SW-MK-02, but it fails to acquire an IP address from the DHCP server. Can you check if the scope is exhausted?
resolution: Mapped the static MAC address to the correct scope and increased DHCP lease pool size.

title: SQL Server connection timeout on App-Prod-01
description: We are experiencing intermittent connection timeouts when the application attempts to query the primary SQL Server instance. The application logs show 'System.Data.SqlClient.SqlException: Execution Timeout Expired' occurring frequently during peak hours. Server is running Windows Server 2019.
resolution: Increased the command timeout threshold in the connection string and optimized the indexing on the Orders table to reduce query latency.

title: AutoCAD license error
description: Getting error 1.10.1 when launching AutoCAD 2024. It says the license is in use on another machine, but I have already signed out of my other device. Please help fix this.
resolution: Reset the Autodesk local login cache files to force a fresh authentication with the license server.

title: Deadlock detected on Production DB
description: We are seeing frequent deadlock errors (Error 1205) in our production MySQL 8.0 instance on Ubuntu 22.04. It appears two specific update scripts are conflicting on the 'Inventory' table. We need this resolved immediately to prevent inventory synchronization errors.
resolution: Modified transaction isolation levels for the conflicting scripts and implemented a retry logic wrapper in the application code.

title: VPN connection drops every 15 minutes
description: I'm working remotely on Windows 11 and my GlobalProtect VPN keeps disconnecting. It usually happens right when I'm in a Teams call, which is incredibly frustrating. Error code 0x1404 is appearing in the logs. Can someone look at this ASAP?
resolution: Updated the GlobalProtect client to version 6.0.4 and cleared the local cache to resolve certificate timeout issues.

title: Absolute disaster - server room AC off
description: Heads up, the CRAC unit is down and the server room is hitting 95 degrees! We’re at risk of hardware failure if this isn’t sorted ASAP—can someone head over there right away?
resolution: Escalated to HVAC vendor; failed control board replaced. Temperature returned to standard 68 degrees within 45 minutes.

title: Core Switch-02 port flapping
description: Port Gi0/1 on Core-Switch-02 is flapping intermittently, causing dropped packets for the Accounting VLAN. Logs show 'LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN' every 30 seconds. We need a physical inspection of the SFP module or the patch cable.
resolution: Replaced faulty SFP+ transceiver and verified link stability with no further flap errors.

title: Printer connectivity issues
description: Hey, the printer in the Marketing area is acting up and showing an "IP Address Conflict" error on the screen. It’s totally offline, so nobody can get their reports printed. Could someone take a look when they have a sec?
resolution: Updated the printer to a static IP address outside of the DHCP range and flushed the ARP cache on the local gateway.

title: NAS volume unmounted unexpectedly
description: Our QNAP TS-h886 storage server suddenly dropped the iSCSI target connection around 02:00 AM. Windows Server 2022 clients are reporting 'Error 0x80070035: The network path was not found' when trying to access the mapped drive. Please investigate the logs.
resolution: Re-established link aggregation settings on the switch and forced a remount of the iSCSI target.

title: Salesforce login loop
description: Hey, I’m running into a loop with Salesforce where it keeps kicking me back to the login page right after I enter my MFA code. I already tried clearing my Chrome cache and cookies, but that didn't help. I'm on macOS Sonoma 14.2 if that helps—any ideas?
resolution: Detected an expired session token in the user's browser profile; cleared site data specifically for the Salesforce domain.

title: Application failure during heavy I/O tasks
description: Custom accounting software crashes whenever large reports are generated. The error message is generic 'IO Exception'.
resolution: Resolved storage array controller latency by migrating high-I/O volumes to SSD-tier storage tiers.

title: RAID 5 array degraded
description: One of the drives in our PowerEdge R740 storage array has failed. We have a blinking amber light on slot 4. Everything seems to be running fine for now, but we are worried about data loss if another disk goes out.
resolution: Replaced the faulty SATA drive in slot 4; triggered a manual array rebuild which completed successfully.

title: Unable to run PowerShell scripts as admin
description: My machine (WS-DESK-99) is completely blocked because of these ridiculous execution policy restrictions. I’ve already tried running 'Set-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned' myself, but surprise, surprise—it’s throwing an "access denied" error. I have actual work to do and I’m currently dead in the water; I need this fixed immediately so I can finally finish my testing.
resolution: Granted temporary local administrator rights to user to update the execution policy for their development environment.

title: Unable to access AWS Management Console
description: I am receiving an 'AccessDenied' error when attempting to reach the production S3 buckets via the AWS CLI. My IAM user has the appropriate policy attached, but it seems to be failing on MFA validation. This is a blocker for our deployment.
resolution: Reset the IAM user's MFA device session to force re-synchronization with the hardware token.

title: Query timeout in Reporting DB
description: My queries are timing out again. I'm trying to pull the Q3 sales report but the server just hangs for 30 seconds and then gives me a 'Query Execution Timeout' error. Using DBeaver on MacOS to connect.
resolution: Added missing indexes to the 'Transactions' table and updated database statistics to improve query plan optimization.

title: Production DB storage reaching capacity
description: Alert: The storage volume on the primary database server is at 92%. We need to expand the EBS volume on this AWS instance before we hit a hard stop and cause a system outage.
resolution: Expanded the EBS volume from 500GB to 1TB and performed online file system expansion.

title: iSCSI connection dropped
description: One of our ESXi hosts dropped the connection to the iSCSI target. The host went into PSOD. Please check the network switch configuration for potential Jumbo Frame mismatches.
resolution: Detected a misconfigured MTU setting on the new switch port; corrected to 9000 bytes to match the storage network fabric.

title: SSD wear level alert
description: Our monitoring system sent an alert for server APP-SRV-09. The SSD wear indicator is at 98%. I think we need to look into migrating the data soon.
resolution: Scheduled a maintenance window to migrate the data to a new NVMe drive and decommissioned the aging SSD.

title: Unable to export reports from PowerBI
description: I am writing to formally report an issue regarding the dashboard export functionality. Despite utilizing the desktop application and confirming that my user permissions remain unchanged, the export button is currently disabled and unresponsive. I request an immediate investigation into this technical impediment to restore the expected functionality.
resolution: Updated PowerBI Desktop to the latest monthly release; the issue was caused by an expired local authentication token.

title: UPS Battery Warning
description: The APC Smart-UPS in the server room is chirping and the front panel displays 'Replace Battery'. I'm worried about an unexpected shutdown during a power fluctuation. Can we get this serviced before it fails entirely?
resolution: Scheduled maintenance window to replace the battery cartridge while on bypass mode.

title: External partner account access issues
description: Contractor cannot access the portal. Could be their account has reached the end of its life cycle (Access) or they have failed MFA validation (Security).
resolution: Validate account expiration date and re-sync MFA hardware token.

title: Need more space on the Z-drive
description: Hi, I keep getting a 'Disk Full' error whenever I try to save reports to the Z-drive. It's really slowing me down today. Can you please increase the capacity?
resolution: Identified a massive log dump in the user's shared folder; cleared temporary files and increased the volume quota by 50GB.

title: High I/O Wait on SQL Server
description: Our SQL Server 2019 instance on Windows Server 2022 is experiencing massive I/O latency. Disk queues are consistently above 50. The application team is complaining about widespread timeouts across all modules.
resolution: Moved the tempdb files to a dedicated high-performance SSD drive and updated outdated statistics on the largest tables.

title: Accidental file deletion
description: I accidentally deleted the entire project folder from the 'Shared-Projects' network drive. I need these files recovered immediately, please. It was the folder named 'Marketing_Campaign_2024'.
resolution: Restored the folder structure from the previous night's Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) backup to a recovery partition for user verification.

title: NAS volume unmounted after power flicker
description: Our QNAP TS-873A unit lost connection after a brief power outage in the server room. The web interface shows 'Volume 1: Not Mounted' and the status LED is blinking red. I've tried rebooting twice but the volume remains inaccessible.
resolution: Performed a manual file system check (fsck) via SSH and re-mounted the volume; ensured the UPS battery backup was functioning correctly.

title: Exporting data for compliance request
description: Hi, I need a CSV export of all login logs for the user 'john.doe' from the last 6 months for a security audit. Please let me know when this is available and where I can download it.
resolution: Ran the query to extract the audit logs, exported the data to a secure S3 bucket, and provided the requester with a time-limited download link.

title: PostgreSQL replication lag
description: Streaming replication lag between db-master and db-replica-01 has exceeded 5GB of WAL files. The pg_stat_replication view shows state 'streaming' but high byte latency. We need to stabilize this before the midnight batch job starts.
resolution: Identified a network throughput bottleneck; routed replication traffic through the dedicated secondary NIC.

title: ERP System crashing on boot
description: The SAP GUI crashes immediately upon launch with error code 0x80040154. This is a critical issue as we cannot process invoices for the month-end closing. Please help ASAP.
resolution: Re-registered the missing DLL files (saplogon.dll) and performed a repair installation of the SAP GUI client.

title: Salesforce login loop on Chrome
description: I'm stuck in an infinite redirect loop when trying to access Salesforce on Chrome version 122.0.6261. I have cleared my cache and cookies multiple times, but the issue persists on both my workstation and laptop. This is preventing me from updating client records for the end-of-month report.
resolution: Cleared site-specific storage settings and disabled a conflicting browser extension causing the redirect loop.

title: Forgot my passcode for encrypted laptop
description: I'm an idiot. I just set up my encrypted drive password this morning and I've already forgotten it. I'm locked out of my files and I really need these documents for the board meeting today. Can you reset it?
resolution: Verified user identity via manager. Utilized escrowed recovery password from the security vault to unlock the drive and helped user set a new, compliant password.

title: Unauthorized software detected
description: We received an automated alert that an unauthorized application, 'Advanced IP Scanner', was installed on WS-042. This violates our company policy regarding network scanning tools. Please remove it immediately.
resolution: Remotely uninstalled the blacklisted application via SCCM. Issued a formal warning to the user regarding software installation policy.

title: USB drive blocked
description: My manager asked me to transfer files to an external thumb drive, but the system keeps saying 'Access Denied'. This is very frustrating as we have a deadline.
resolution: Applied group policy exception for the user's specific USB device ID to allow encrypted read/write access per security department approval.

title: Microsoft Teams background blur failing
description: Hey, whenever I turn on background blur, my camera just goes black. I'm on a Dell Latitude 5420. Can someone fix this?
resolution: Updated the integrated camera drivers and ensured the latest Teams desktop client was installed.

title: Schema sync failure
description: Hey, staging is currently out of sync with prod. Looks like migration script v2.4 hit a syntax error near 'MODIFY COLUMN'—we're running on CentOS 7 if that helps.
resolution: Fixed invalid syntax in migration file and ran the apply script manually.

title: Storage array reporting overheating
description: We received an alert from the data center monitoring system that the main SAN array is reporting a temperature warning for controller B. It is currently at 65 degrees Celsius. Please check if a fan has failed.
resolution: Replaced a faulty cooling fan module and verified that the sensor readings returned to the normal operational range.

title: VLAN tagging issue
description: New machines in the dev lab are not picking up the correct VLAN 20. They are defaulting to the native VLAN 1. Please check the switch config.
resolution: Reconfigured the trunk port to correctly tag packets for VLAN 20 and performed a port bounce.

title: Permission issue with SQL DB
description: I am trying to connect to the production SQL Server 2022 instance, but I am receiving an error stating that I do not have sufficient permissions to view the sys.databases view. I am using SSMS 19.3.
resolution: Granted 'VIEW ANY DATABASE' permission to the user's AD domain group on the SQL instance.

title: Why is the internet so bad?
description: Everything is running slow. Everything. My email, the browser, everything. Is the server down again?
resolution: Identified high bandwidth usage from a user running a P2P application and blocked the port.

title: Cloud sync storage error
description: Our local-to-S3 storage gateway is stuck in a sync loop. It keeps throwing '403 Forbidden' errors when uploading chunk files. We haven't changed our AWS IAM keys recently.
resolution: Rotated the IAM access keys and updated the gateway configuration to restore secure connectivity to the S3 bucket.

title: Adobe Acrobat Pro crashing on launch
description: Every time I open a PDF, Acrobat Pro 2023 crashes immediately. I get an error code 0xc0000005. Running Windows 11 Enterprise. Help.
resolution: Performed a clean re-installation of Adobe Acrobat using the Creative Cloud Cleaner Tool to resolve corrupted registry keys.

title: Ethernet port dead
description: My laptop doesn't detect a network cable when plugged into the wall jack in room 204. I've tried a different cable and a different laptop, still nothing. Help.
resolution: Traced the wall jack to a disconnected patch cable in the server room; re-patched and tested for signal.

title: Minor formatting adjustment requested
description: It would be lovely if you could look into why the entire production database has been wiped. No rush at all, whenever you have a free moment today would be just fine.
resolution: Restored database from hourly snapshot and performed integrity check.

title: Total site outage
description: The entire building has lost connectivity. We have no internet or internal access. Users are panicking.
resolution: Found an upstream service provider outage; engaged ISP support and transitioned traffic to the redundant backup line.

title: Login failed
description: I am completely blocked from the database and keep getting an account locked error. I have a critical deadline in an hour, so I need this fixed immediately—I cannot afford to sit around waiting while I fall behind on my work.
resolution: Unlocked the user account and verified the password expiration policy settings.

title: Cloud storage bucket permissions
description: Hey team, we’re running into 403 Forbidden errors when trying to push logs to the prod-logs-storage S3 bucket. We’ve already double-checked and the IAM role definitely has s3:PutObject permissions, so not sure why it's still acting up. Any ideas?
resolution: Corrected the bucket policy which was inadvertently blocking access from the VPC endpoint.

title: Locked out of AD account
description: I'm locked out again. I've tried my password three times and now it says 'Account is locked due to multiple failed attempts'. This is the third time this week, please help.
resolution: Unlocked the AD account and cleared cached credentials on the user's workstation that were causing repeated lockout triggers.

title: Unable to connect to the office network via Ethernet
description: I just plugged my laptop into the wall jack in conference room B, but the network icon just shows a red 'X'. I've tried two different Cat6 cables. Is the port even live?
resolution: Enabled the switch port on the edge switch, which had been set to 'shutdown' following an unauthorized port discovery attempt.

title: Intermittent packet loss on VOIP phone
description: My desk phone, model Polycom VVX 410, has been crackling and dropping calls all morning. My coworker in the next cubicle is having the same issue. It’s making it impossible to take client calls.
resolution: Identified a duplex mismatch on the phone's patch port; switched to a new CAT6 cable and verified 1Gbps link speed.

title: BitLocker recovery screen
description: My laptop (Dell Latitude 5420) is stuck on the BitLocker recovery blue screen after a Windows update. It’s asking for a 48-digit recovery key that I don't have. I have a deadline in an hour.
resolution: Retrieved recovery key from Azure AD device portal and successfully unlocked the drive.

title: Outlook search functionality broken
description: Searching for emails in Outlook 365 yields zero results even for messages I can see in my inbox. Running Windows 10. The search bar just spins and returns 'No results found'.
resolution: Rebuilt the Windows Search Index for Outlook and repaired the Office 365 installation.

title: Rack fan failure
description: I am formally reporting a critical hardware malfunction regarding Server-Rack-1. The cooling fan located at the base of the unit is emitting an abnormal high-pitched whistling noise and has ceased operation. Consequently, the ambient temperature within the rack is escalating rapidly, posing an immediate risk to the hosted equipment. I request an urgent inspection and resolution of this cooling failure to prevent potential system damage or downtime.
resolution: Replaced the failed 120mm exhaust fan assembly with a spare unit from inventory.

title: Device not compliant with security policy
description: My MacBook Pro (macOS Sonoma) is being blocked from accessing company resources. The Company Portal app says I'm non-compliant, but I haven't changed any settings. I really need access to Slack.
resolution: Sync performed on Intune; detected that OS security patch level was outdated. Triggered an update and re-enrolled the device.

title: PostgreSQL service failing to start
description: Postgres won't start after the server rebooted last night. The logs show 'FATAL: could not create shared memory segment'. It seems like a kernel configuration issue with shmmax.
resolution: Adjusted the kernel.shmmax and kernel.shmall settings in /etc/sysctl.conf to provide sufficient shared memory for the increased database buffer cache size.

title: MFA device lost
description: I lost my phone that had the Microsoft Authenticator app on it. Now I can't log into my email. How do I get back in?
resolution: Verified user identity via manager, reset the MFA requirement for the account, and assisted the user in setting up a new device.

title: Salesforce page load timeout
description: When attempting to load the 'Leads' dashboard on Salesforce, the page hangs indefinitely and eventually displays a 504 Gateway Timeout error. This is occurring on Chrome version 124.0.6367.60 across multiple workstations in the marketing department. I have cleared the browser cache, but the issue persists.
resolution: Increased session timeout threshold on the proxy server and whitelisted specific Salesforce IP ranges in the corporate firewall.

title: Low disk space on file server
description: The D: drive on FS-01 is reporting less than 5GB free space. Windows Server 2019 is throwing constant 'Disk space critically low' notifications. Users are complaining that they cannot save new documents to the shared folder.
resolution: Cleared temporary log files and performed a temporary storage expansion of the underlying LUN.

title: Unauthorized device detected on secure port
description: This correspondence serves as a formal notification regarding a security breach detected by the Intrusion Detection System. An unauthorized device, currently identified as "unknown," has been detected connected to port 48 within the server room. The device is actively engaging in unauthorized reconnaissance by attempting to probe internal subnets, necessitating an immediate investigation and containment.
resolution: Identified device as an unmanaged switch brought in by a contractor; port was shut down and contractor notified.

title: Need a staging data refresh
description: Hey, could you please refresh the staging database with a sanitized dump from production? The current data is outdated and it's making testing very difficult.
resolution: Executed a partial data dump from production, ran a masking script to obfuscate PII, and restored to the staging environment.

title: Java application runtime error
description: The accounting software is throwing a 'java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space' error during month-end processing. I have 16GB of RAM assigned to the VM. Please advise.
resolution: Adjusted the Xmx heap size parameters in the application configuration file to allow for larger data processing loads.

title: Tableau workbook error
description: I'm receiving an 'Internal Error: Data source not found' when trying to refresh the extract for the quarterly financial workbook. Version is 2023.1. I checked the SQL connection and it seems fine.
resolution: Updated the expired service account credentials in the Tableau Server data source settings.

title: Unauthorized login alert from unknown location
description: I got an automated email notification saying someone logged into my Microsoft 365 account from an IP address in a different country. I am currently in the office in Chicago. I am worried my account has been compromised.
resolution: Invalidated all active session tokens and forced a password reset for the user. Verified login history shows no successful data exfiltration.

title: SharePoint folder access denied
description: I cannot access the 'Q3 Financials' folder on the team SharePoint site. I have the link, but it tells me 'Access Denied: You do not have permission to view this directory.' My teammates can see it just fine.
resolution: Granted the user 'Viewer' access to the specific SharePoint sub-folder and forced a permission propagation sync.

title: DNS resolution failing for internal portal
description: Every time I try to access the company portal (portal.internal.corp), I get a 'DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN' error in Chrome. It works fine if I use the VPN, but not on the local office network.
resolution: Corrected the internal DNS record which had been incorrectly pointed to the external IP during the last server migration.

title: Permissions issue on /mnt/data
description: I cannot access the research share anymore. When I try to browse to the folder, I get an 'Access Denied' error even though I have read/write permissions. This started after the server reboot last night.
resolution: Reset the NFS export permissions and re-synchronized the user UID/GID mapping with the LDAP server.

title: Antivirus alert on server SRV-04
description: I’m losing my mind here—CrowdStrike just triggered an alert for some garbage process running out of the Temp folders on SRV-04, and it’s clearly trying to execute an encoded PowerShell script. I’ve already had to isolate the server from the network just to stop it from moving laterally, because apparently, we can't have a secure environment for five minutes. This needs immediate attention before everything else goes down.
resolution: Identified malicious script as a false positive from a legitimate internal deployment tool and restored service.

title: NFS mount timeout on production web server
description: Our web-prod-04 server is failing to mount the /mnt/data storage volume. We are receiving 'RPC: Timed out' errors when attempting to mount the NFS share. This is impacting our ability to serve static assets to customers.
resolution: Increased the NFS timeout threshold in /etc/fstab and identified a congested network switch port causing packet loss.

title: DNS resolution failing for internal apps
description: Some of our internal web apps aren't resolving. nslookup keeps timing out when hitting our internal DNS servers. It seems like the zones aren't replicating between DC1 and DC2.
resolution: Forced a manual synchronization of the DNS zones between domain controllers and cleared the DNS cache.

title: Permission denied on file share
description: I cannot access the 'Marketing_Archive' folder on the corporate NAS anymore. It says 'Access Denied' whenever I try to open a sub-folder. I have a presentation due in an hour, help!
resolution: Reset ACL permissions for the user group, as an inadvertent change in AD security groups had removed their read access.

title: VPN connection failing with error 806
description: My VPN keeps crashing. I'm trying to connect from home and I keep getting error 806. I've restarted my laptop twice and verified my credentials are correct.
resolution: Updated firewall policy to allow GRE protocol traffic for the remote user's IP.

title: SAML SSO error on Chrome
description: Hey, I'm running into an "Error 403: app_not_configured_for_user" when trying to launch Salesforce through Okta. I'm on Chrome v118 and Windows 11, and it seems like everyone else on the team is getting in fine. Any idea what's up?
resolution: Assigned the user to the Salesforce application integration in Okta Admin Console.

title: MFA prompt loop on mobile device
description: Every time I try to sign into O365 on my iPhone, the Microsoft Authenticator app just spins and eventually says 'Request timed out'. I’ve tried reinstalling the app and updating iOS to 17.4. It's really frustrating, please help.
resolution: Removed user's old MFA device registration from Azure AD and prompted user to re-register their device.

title: BitLocker recovery screen on boot
description: My laptop (Dell Latitude 5420) is stuck on a blue BitLocker recovery screen immediately after the BIOS post. It’s asking for a 48-digit recovery key that I don't have. I need to get back into my machine ASAP.
resolution: Retrieved recovery key from Azure AD portal and successfully unlocked the drive. Performed a 'manage-bde -protectors -adbackup' to ensure future recovery keys are synced.

title: Database connection timeout
description: The internal BI dashboard is throwing a 'Connection Timeout' error after 30 seconds of loading. It seems like a backend issue, but I wanted to report it before I get a ticket from the users.
resolution: Increased the SQL query timeout threshold on the application server connection string.

title: VPN connection failing with Error 807
description: I can't connect to the office network from my home office. I keep getting Error 807. I've tried restarting my router and my laptop running Windows 11, but no luck.
resolution: Identified an expired security certificate on the VPN gateway. Renewed the SSL certificate and re-provisioned the tunnel configuration.

title: Can't access mapped network drives
description: Hey, I'm getting an error message when I try to open the 'Z:' drive. It says 'The network path was not found.' I've tried restarting my laptop, but no luck.
resolution: Mapped the network drive using the server FQDN instead of the IP address to resolve DNS lookup issues.

title: Access to Shared Mailbox
description: I need full access permissions to the 'Support-Tier-1' shared mailbox. I am not seeing it pop up in my Outlook 365 client despite being added to the distribution list last week.
resolution: Added the user to the 'Full Access' list in the Exchange Admin Center and confirmed automapping is enabled.

title: WAP in Lobby is down
description: The Cisco Aironet access point in the main lobby stopped broadcasting the SSID. It's not showing any lights, even though it's connected to a PoE+ switch port. We need this fixed for the guests.
resolution: Verified switch port was shut down due to a power budget conflict; reconfigured PoE priority settings.

title: New hire onboarding access
description: We have a new engineer starting on Monday. Please provision access for AD, GitHub Enterprise, and the internal Wiki for the user j.doe.
resolution: Created user account, added to relevant security groups, and sent provisioning email.

title: Unable to export report in Chrome
description: The export to Excel button in our web portal just stopped working. Nothing happens when I click it. Please fix it ASAP.
resolution: Resolved a conflict caused by a recent browser extension update; advised user to disable the specific 'PDF Converter' extension.

title: Slow query performance on reporting dashboard
description: Hey, the dashboard is dragging. Specifically, the sales report takes like 30 seconds to load now. Can you take a look?
resolution: Added a missing composite index on the 'transaction_date' and 'merchant_id' columns, reducing query execution time from 28s to 450ms.

title: Charset mismatch on new entries
description: We are seeing weird characters in our database for non-English names. It looks like the database is using Latin1 but we are inserting UTF-8 data. We need to fix this character encoding issue ASAP.
resolution: Altered the database character set and collation to utf8mb4 and performed an encoding conversion on the existing table data.

title: SQL Server connection timeout on App-Prod-01
description: We are experiencing intermittent connection timeouts when the web application attempts to query the primary SQL Server 2019 instance on App-Prod-01. The logs show error code 0x80004005, and it seems to happen primarily during peak traffic hours between 2 PM and 4 PM. We need an investigation into the connection pool settings.
resolution: Increased the Max Pool Size in the application connection string and optimized three long-running stored procedures that were causing lock contention.

title: UPS battery fault
description: My UPS unit in the server room is beeping incessantly. The LCD panel is flashing an 'Error 05 - Battery Replace' code. Can someone please check this before it shuts down the rack?
resolution: Replaced the depleted lead-acid battery cartridge and performed a successful self-test.

title: Potential malware infection on workstation
description: I noticed some weird pop-ups appearing on my monitor while browsing. I'm worried I clicked something bad. Currently running a scan with Defender but nothing is showing up yet.
resolution: Remotely performed a full scan via EDR; quarantined a malicious browser extension and performed a clean-up of temporary browser files.

title: Firewall Rule propagation failure
description: I tried to push a new policy to the Palo Alto PA-5220, but it failed with an 'Invalid Object Reference' error. Now the commit is stuck at 70%. Need to ensure production traffic isn't impacted.
resolution: Cleaned up orphaned address objects and successfully completed the commit/push operation.

title: DNS resolution latency
description: DNS queries are taking up to 2 seconds to resolve. This is making everything feel extremely sluggish. Is our forwarder down?
resolution: Removed a dead DNS forwarder entry and pointed the DNS servers to a more responsive public DNS resolver.

title: Admin password reset
description: I am working on the server stack and need a temporary elevated credential for testing the new firewall rules on SRV-DB-01. Please reset the dev-admin password.
resolution: Provisioned a time-bound administrative account through the PAM (Privileged Access Management) portal with a 4-hour expiration window.

title: Request to whitelist a new software tool
description: I am trying to run a simple automation script for my project on Ubuntu 22.04, but your ridiculous security software is blocking it again. This is preventing me from getting any actual work done. Can you please just whitelist the damn tool so I can stop wasting my time on this?
resolution: Reviewed the binary's hash and source origin. Added an exclusion rule for the specific file path in the endpoint security console.

title: Suspicious PowerShell activity
description: Our SOC alert just triggered for this device. It shows an obfuscated PowerShell script running as system privileges. Please investigate the logs.
resolution: Identified malicious script execution initiated by a compromised third-party plugin. Disabled the plugin, updated software version, and performed a full system audit.

title: Slack not showing new notifications
description: I am beyond fed up with Slack on my M2 MacBook Pro. I am getting zero push notifications for DMs despite my settings being configured correctly. I have already wasted time restarting the app three times and it is still completely broken. Fix this immediately.
resolution: Reset Slack notification preferences and verified that macOS Focus mode was not blocking the app.

title: Minor latency on guest Wi-Fi
description: I noticed the guest network in the lobby is running a bit slow this morning. No rush at all, but if someone could look at it when they have a free moment next week, that would be lovely.
resolution: Reset backbone switch stack to restore full bandwidth capacity.

title: Domain Controller NTP sync
description: Everything is falling apart because our time synchronization is completely broken across the entire domain. DC01 is running five minutes ahead of the PDC emulator, and it's causing constant Kerberos authentication failures. Fix this immediately.
resolution: Reconfigured the PDC to sync with an external stratum-1 NTP source and forced a w32tm /resync on all DCs.

title: I can't reach the fileshare
description: Hey, I'm having trouble connecting to \\FS-PROD-01—getting a timeout error when trying to map the drive. Already tried restarting my laptop, but no luck. Anyone able to take a look?
resolution: Reset the SMB service on the file server and cleared stale TCP connections from the firewall state table.

title: Slow login/latency on internal app
description: Users are complaining that the internal tool is very sluggish when loading the user profiles list. Database logs show high wait times for 'PAGEIOLATCH_SH'. It seems like disk latency is spiking during peak hours on the SAN.
resolution: Identified a heavy query performing full table scans; introduced a covering index to reduce disk I/O and improved performance by 80%.

title: Server rack overheating alert
description: The environmental monitor just sent an automated critical alert for Rack 2. The internal temperature has spiked to 92 degrees Fahrenheit. Please investigate the HVAC unit immediately.
resolution: Building management cleared a debris blockage in the CRAC unit intake; temperatures normalized within an hour.

title: VPN connection failure
description: Hey, is anyone else having trouble with the VPN after the Cisco AnyConnect 4.10 update? It was working fine yesterday, but now it’s just throwing an "Unable to establish connection to the remote gateway" error whenever I try to connect.
resolution: Updated the root certificate store on the local client machine and re-authenticated the user against the RADIUS server.

title: Account locked out again
description: My account keeps locking me out every 30 minutes! I am using Windows 11 Enterprise. It says 'Account locked due to too many failed attempts' but I haven't typed my password in. This is extremely frustrating.
resolution: Identified a stale cached credential on the user's mobile device triggering background authentication failures; cleared credentials and forced a re-auth.

title: Disk space warning
description: My laptop is complaining that the hard drive is almost full. It keeps popping up a notification saying 'Startup Disk Almost Full' every time I open Adobe Premiere. Can you help me figure out what's taking up all the room?
resolution: Ran WinDirStat/DaisyDisk analysis, identified 40GB of redundant cache files, and cleared the temporary folder and old project logs.

title: Partial data center outage
description: We are experiencing packet loss affecting the racks in row B. It seems isolated to the secondary leaf switch. Multiple servers are reporting interface flaps in the system logs.
resolution: Replaced the SFP+ module on the uplink port which was reporting CRC errors and failing to maintain 10Gbps link integrity.

title: Blocked website access
description: Why am I blocked from using standard online tools? I need to look up documentation for a client project and the firewall is throwing an 'Access Denied: Category: Malicious Sites' error for a site I know is safe.
resolution: Reviewed the site's reputation, whitelisted the URL in the Zscaler policy, and cleared the user's browser cache.

title: DHCP Scope Exhaustion
description: Users in the Guest-WiFi VLAN are unable to pull IP addresses. Checking the Windows Server 2019 DHCP console, the address pool for 192.168.50.0/24 is completely exhausted. We need to expand this range or shorten lease times.
resolution: Expanded DHCP scope to 192.168.50.0/23 and decreased lease duration to 4 hours.

title: External HDD not showing up
description: Hey, I plugged in my WD My Passport drive to my laptop but it doesn't appear in File Explorer. I tried unplugging and plugging it back in, but nothing happens. Is there a driver I need?
resolution: Updated the USB Mass Storage driver via Device Manager and reassigned a drive letter in Disk Management.

title: Office lights are flickering
description: Persistent flickering of the lighting fixtures in the west wing has recurred. I am concerned that these electrical fluctuations may pose a stability risk to the adjacent server infrastructure. Please dispatch a technician to investigate and resolve this issue as a matter of urgency.
resolution: Electrical contractor tightened a loose neutral wire in the main circuit breaker panel.

title: Latency spikes in SQL cluster
description: We are seeing significant I/O latency on the SQL-Cluster-02 nodes. The storage array reports increased 'read wait' times during the nightly backup window. This is slowing down production databases significantly.
resolution: Optimized backup scheduling to off-peak hours and updated firmware on the SAN controller.
